title: Manager - Operations
description:
Office Manager – Operations

**Location:** Sector 82, Mohali  
**Type:** Full\-time

**Reports to:** Owner

**About the Role**

We are looking for an organized and proactive Office Manager to oversee administrative operations and inventory management across our kitchen and store functions. This role is central to keeping our records accurate, our stock levels controlled, and communication flowing smoothly between our kitchen, stores, and management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain accurate digital inventory records using Petpooja or similar softwares, keeping stock levels, recipes, and pricing consistently up to date.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile them against digital inventory records, promptly flagging and resolving any discrepancies.
* Coordinate purchase orders with vendors and suppliers, following up to ensure timely and accurate deliveries.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory and operational reports, along with management presentations, using Excel and PowerPoint.
* Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems for invoices, vendor agreements, licenses, and other business records.
* Support HR\-related administrative tasks, including attendance tracking, leave records, and onboarding documentation for staff.
* Track petty cash, day\-to\-day expenses, and basic bookkeeping entries.
* Act as the coordination point between kitchen, store, and management teams, ensuring smooth information flow and timely resolution of administrative issues.
* Oversee general office administration, including supplies, upkeep, and vendor/service coordination, while ensuring documentation and licensing stay compliant with company and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications \& Skills

* Minimum 5 years of experience in office administration, inventory management, or operations support — experience in a bakery, F\&B, or QSR/cloud kitchen environment is preferred.
* Proficiency in Petpooja or similar POS/restaurant management software.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable with Google Workspace.
* Proven experience managing both digital and physical inventory systems.
* Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
* Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work across kitchen, store, and management teams.
* Must be based out of, or willing to relocate to, Sector 82, Mohali.
* Working knowledge of vendor coordination, billing, and invoicing processes.
* Ability to multitask and stay composed in a fast\-paced F\&B environment.

Why Join Us?

Be part of a growing, quality\-focused brand with a loyal customer base and a close\-knit team. Your organization and attention to detail will directly support smoother day\-to\-day operations and help us continue delivering a consistent, high\-quality experience to our customers.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

**Job Description: Operation Theatre (OT) Technician**

**Operation Theatre (OT) Technician**

Department

Operation Theatre (OT)

Qualification

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Operation Theatre Technology (DOTT/B.Sc. Operation Theatre Technology) or an equivalent recognized qualification.
* Certification in Basic Life Support (BLS) is preferred.

Experience

* Minimum 1 year of experience as an OT Technician in a hospital or surgical center.
* Freshers with relevant clinical training or internship may be considered.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare the operation theatre before surgical procedures by ensuring cleanliness, sterility, and readiness of equipment.
* Arrange and sterilize surgical instruments, drapes, consumables, and other equipment required for surgeries.
* Assist surgeons, anesthetists, and nursing staff during surgical procedures.
* Ensure the proper functioning of OT equipment, including operating tables, suction machines, cautery units, monitors, lights, and anesthesia machines, and promptly report any malfunction.
* Maintain aseptic techniques and comply with infection prevention and control protocols.
* Assist in patient positioning, transfer, and preparation before and after surgery.
* Count surgical instruments, needles, and sponges before, during, and after procedures in coordination with the OT nursing staff.
* Clean, disinfect, and prepare the operation theatre for subsequent procedures.
* Maintain records of OT instruments, equipment, sterilization, and inventory.
* Ensure adequate stock of surgical supplies and communicate replenishment requirements to the appropriate department.
* Handle biomedical waste according to hospital policies and statutory guidelines.
* Support emergency and trauma surgeries as required.
* Participate in OT quality improvement initiatives, safety audits, and continuing education programs.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of operation theatre procedures and sterile techniques.
* Familiarity with surgical instruments and OT equipment.
* Understanding of infection prevention and biomedical waste management.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and respond to emergency situations.
* Good communication, teamwork, and organizational skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to patient safety.

Working Conditions

* Rotational shifts, including day, evening, night, weekends, and public holidays.
* Availability for emergency and on\-call duties as per hospital requirements.

title: HR and Marketing Executive
description:
We are seeking a versatile and dynamic **HR \& Social Media Executive** to manage our core employee relations while driving our digital presence.

In this dual\-function role, you will oversee end\-to\-end HR operations—from attendance and performance to employee escalations and basic accounting—while simultaneously building our brand story through creative social media management, content creation, and digital marketing.

If you are a people\-person who loves creating engaging digital content and thrives in a fast\-paced environment, this is an exciting opportunity to make a direct impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Human Resources \& Internal Operations**

* **Employee Management:** Oversee onboarding, offboarding, employee records, attendance, and leave tracking.
* **Performance \& Escalations:** Track KPI metrics, conduct performance reviews, handle staff grievances, and resolve internal team escalations promptly.
* **Basic Accounting \& Payroll:** Process monthly attendance for payroll, track staff allowances/reimbursements, and manage basic departmental accounting records.
* **Workplace Culture:** Foster a positive work culture across clinical and non\-clinical staff.

**Social Media, Design \& Marketing**

* **Social Media Management:** Plan, schedule, and publish regular content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profile.
* **Content \& Poster Design:** Create eye\-catching posters, flyers, reels, and digital graphics for promotions, health campaigns, and hospital updates (using Canva, Photoshop, or similar tools).
* **Digital Marketing:** Execute targeted ad campaigns (Meta Ads / Google Ads) to increase local community reach and pet parent engagement.
* **Online Engagement:** Respond to comments, direct messages, and online reviews professionally to maintain a positive brand reputation.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–5 years of experience handling HR operations, administrative tasks, or social media management (experience in healthcare, retail, or hospitality is a plus).
* **HR Tools \& Accounting:** Familiarity with basic HRMS tools, attendance tracking software, and MS Excel/Tally for basic accounting.
* **Creative Tools:** Proficiency in **Canva**, Adobe Creative Suite, or video editing apps (InShot, CapCut) for creating social media graphics and short\-form video reels.
* **Digital Marketing:** Practical knowledge of Meta Business Suite, basic ad targeting, and local SEO/Google Business profile optimization.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong conflict\-resolution abilities.

**Desired Attributes**

* **Multitasking Excellence:** Ability to balance structured administrative HR schedules with fast\-moving social media trends.
* **Empathy \& Professionalism:** Good judgment when handling employee sensitive issues or customer inquiries online.
* **Affinity for Pets:** Comfortable working in a pet\-friendly hospital environment.

title: Co-Founder and Medical Doctor (MBBS)
description:
About Mednevo

Mednevo is an early\-stage AI healthcare startup revolutionizing \*primary healthcare\* in India. We combine \*cutting\-edge AI technology\* with a genuine patient\-first approach to deliver accessible, personalized, and high\-quality care. Our platform integrates \*on\-demand virtual consultations, in\-home doctor visits, proactive wellness monitoring, and AI\-powered tools for interactive consultations, patient education, and personalized health insights.

We are particularly focused on making quality care — including pediatric care — more efficient, affordable, and scalable across urban and semi\-urban India. As a small, high\-impact team (2\-10 people), we move fast and solve real problems: reducing wait times, supporting clinical decisions with AI, improving outcomes for families and children, and building the future of intelligent healthcare delivery.

The Opportunity We are looking for a passionate Medical Doctor to join as a Co\-Founder. This is not a traditional clinical job — it is a founding leadership role where you will shape the clinical vision, build the product alongside AI engineers, and help scale a mission\-driven healthcare ecosystem. You will bring real\-world medical expertise (especially in pediatrics) to ensure our AI tools are clinically accurate, safe, empathetic, and truly useful for Indian families and doctors.

Key Responsibilities **⁠ ⁠**

**Clinical Leadership \& Product Vision: Co\-define the medical strategy and clinical pathways, with special focus on pediatric care, primary health, preventive wellness, and common childhood conditions.** ⁠ ⁠AI \+ Medicine Integration: Work closely with AI engineers to train, validate, and refine AI models for symptom assessment, triage, personalized advice, and decision support. description:

**ORIGENNT Private Limited**  
**Department:** Business Development \& Consulting  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** As Assigned  
**Reporting To:** Co\-Founder / National Sales Head

ABOUT ORIGENNT

ORIGENNT Private Limited is a growing Management Consulting and Business Enablement Company focused on helping organizations achieve sustainable growth through strategic consulting, operational improvement, and execution\-driven solutions.

ORIGENNT works with businesses and institutions across multiple sectors, including Startups, MSMEs, Healthcare Institutions, Manufacturing Companies, Educational Organizations, Hospitality Businesses, Real Estate Firms, IT Companies, Retail Enterprises, Logistics Providers, NGOs, and Professional Service Organizations.

The Company's integrated service portfolio includes:

* Management Consulting
* Business Strategy \& Growth Consulting
* HR Consulting \& Recruitment
* Branding \& Digital Marketing
* Website \& Mobile Application Development
* SOP Development \& Process Consulting
* Corporate Training
* Business Registration \& Compliance Support
* CRM \& ERP Consulting
* Performance Management Systems
* Business Automation

POSITION OVERVIEW

The **Area General Manager (AGM) – Business Growth \& Consulting** is a strategic leadership position responsible for driving business expansion, revenue growth, client acquisition, market development, and team performance within an assigned territory.

The AGM will serve as a senior representative of ORIGENNT and will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, developing corporate relationships, acquiring clients, presenting consulting solutions, leading sales and growth teams, and contributing directly to the Company's regional and national expansion objectives.

The role requires a commercially driven professional with strong leadership ability, strategic thinking, business development expertise, consulting orientation, and the ability to manage people, performance, processes, and client relationships.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Regional Business Growth

* Develop and execute regional business expansion strategies aligned with ORIGENNT's organizational vision and quarterly objectives.
* Identify new markets, industries, business segments, and growth opportunities.
* Build a strong and sustainable regional business pipeline.
* Contribute to the development of ORIGENNT's market presence and brand reputation.

2\. Business Development \& Client Acquisition

* Identify and qualify prospective corporate, institutional, and business clients also close targets as provided by the company monthly and quarterly.
* Generate leads through direct outreach, networking, referrals, strategic partnerships, events, and other business development channels.
* Conduct business meetings, corporate presentations, discovery meetings, and consulting discussions.
* Understand client challenges and recommend appropriate ORIGENNT solutions.
* Prepare and present business proposals and commercial presentations.
* Lead negotiations and support the conversion of prospects into long\-term clients.

3\. Consulting\-Oriented Sales

* Position ORIGENNT as a strategic business partner rather than merely a service provider.
* Diagnose business challenges and identify opportunities for consulting intervention.
* Develop solution\-oriented proposals based on client requirements.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-selling and upselling ORIGENNT's integrated services.
* Maintain a high standard of professional and ethical business conduct.

4\. Team Leadership \& Performance Management

* Lead, guide, mentor, and monitor Sales \& Growth Consultants within the assigned area.
* Set performance expectations and monitor individual and team productivity.
* Review daily, weekly, and monthly sales activities.
* Monitor lead generation, meetings, proposals, conversions, revenue, and pipeline movement.
* Conduct performance reviews and implement corrective action where required.
* Develop a culture of accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement.

5\. Strategic Partnerships \& Market Development

* Develop referral relationships and strategic alliances.
* Build relationships with business associations, industry professionals, entrepreneurs, institutions, and potential channel partners.
* Represent ORIGENNT at relevant business meetings, conferences, networking events, and industry forums.
* Identify partnership opportunities that can contribute to business growth.

6\. Internal Coordination \& Client Success

* Coordinate with internal consulting, operations, HR, technology, branding, marketing, and execution teams.
* Ensure smooth handover of acquired clients and projects.
* Support the successful execution of client engagements.
* Monitor client satisfaction and relationship quality.
* Identify opportunities for long\-term client retention and account expansion.

7\. Reporting, CRM \& Governance

* Maintain accurate and timely CRM and pipeline records.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly business reports as required.
* Prepare revenue forecasts and pipeline reports.
* Maintain accurate records of client interactions, proposals, negotiations, and business opportunities.
* Comply with all ORIGENNT policies, reporting systems, professional standards, and management directives.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Performance shall be evaluated based on a combination of individual, team, commercial, and strategic performance indicators, including:

* Monthly revenue achievement
* New client acquisition
* Lead generation and lead quality
* Number of qualified business meetings
* Proposal submissions
* Conversion ratio
* Sales pipeline value and health
* Client retention and relationship development
* Cross\-selling and upselling performance
* Sales \& Growth Consultant productivity
* Team revenue performance
* Strategic partnerships developed
* Business expansion initiatives
* CRM and reporting discipline
* Customer satisfaction
* Overall contribution to regional and organizational objectives

QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCEEssential Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University.

Preferred Qualifications

* MBA, PGDM, or equivalent qualification in:
* Business Administration
* Marketing
* Sales
* Management
* Entrepreneurship

Experience

A minimum of **2 years of professional experience** in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Business Development
* Corporate Sales
* Management Consulting
* Client Relationship Management
* Strategic Partnerships
* Team Leadership
* B2B Sales
* Enterprise Sales

Essential Competencies

The candidate should demonstrate:

* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Strong business development capability
* Corporate presentation skills
* Negotiation and commercial understanding
* Leadership and team management ability
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving
* Analytical and decision\-making capability
* Professional client handling
* Target orientation and ownership mindset
* Ability to work independently and lead teams

Proficiency in CRM systems, Microsoft Office, business reporting tools, and digital productivity platforms will be an added advantage.

EMPLOYMENT TERMS \& BENEFITS

The selected candidate shall be appointed subject to the following terms:

Probation

The selected candidate shall undergo a **three\-month probation period**.

**₹14,500 per month during the probation period has been allocated to understand their potentials and performances with opportunity to apply for incentives and bonus policies, regards post probation candidates are allocated a fixed salary of 22,750 per month upto 40,550 per month as per their performances and matrix.**

Performance\-based incentives shall be applicable in accordance with the prevailing **ORIGENNT Incentive Policy**.

Approved official travel expenses incurred for legitimate business purposes shall be reimbursed in accordance with the Company's **Travel \& Reimbursement Policy** and applicable approval procedures within a week,

Continuation of employment and confirmation shall be subject to:

WHY JOIN ORIGENNT?

ORIGENNT provides an entrepreneurial and high\-growth environment where leadership, initiative, innovation, and measurable performance are recognized.

title: HR Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and business\-oriented **HR Manager** to lead and manage the end\-to\-end Human Resources function. The ideal candidate will be responsible for talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, HR operations, policy implementation, payroll coordination, compliance, and organizational development. This role requires someone who can build strong relationships across departments, drive HR initiatives, and foster a high\-performance culture in a fast\-paced environment.

Key ResponsibilitiesTalent Acquisition

* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment across technical and non\-technical roles.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand workforce requirements.
* Develop sourcing strategies through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and recruitment agencies.
* Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
* Improve recruitment metrics including Time\-to\-Hire and Quality\-of\-Hire.

Employee Lifecycle Management

* Manage onboarding, induction, probation, confirmations, and exits.
* Conduct employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Handle employee grievances and conflict resolution.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.

Performance Management

* Drive the performance appraisal process.
* Coordinate goal setting, feedback cycles, and performance reviews.
* Assist managers in identifying high\-potential employees and development plans.
* Support succession planning and career progression initiatives.

HR Operations

* Manage attendance, leave management, payroll inputs, and HRMS.
* Ensure timely documentation, letters, and compliance records.
* Monitor employee data accuracy and reporting.
* Coordinate with Finance for payroll processing.

HR Policies \& Compliance

* Develop and implement HR policies aligned with business needs.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and statutory requirements.
* Handle disciplinary actions and policy enforcement.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.

Learning \& Development

* Identify training needs across departments.
* Coordinate technical, behavioral, and leadership training programs.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning.

Employee Engagement

* Organize employee engagement activities and recognition programs.
* Conduct employee satisfaction surveys.
* Drive initiatives to improve workplace culture and employee well\-being.

HR Analytics \& Reporting

* Prepare monthly HR dashboards and reports.
* Track recruitment, attrition, retention, and engagement metrics.
* Present HR insights and recommendations to leadership.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

Experience

* **5–8 years** of progressive HR experience.
* Experience in IT, SaaS, Product, or Technology organizations is preferred.

Required SkillsTechnical Skills

* Strong knowledge of HR operations and employment laws.
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS platforms (Keka, Darwinbox, Zoho People, BambooHR, etc.).
* Strong recruitment and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with performance management frameworks.
* Payroll coordination and HR compliance knowledge.
* Strong reporting and analytical skills.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong leadership and decision\-making abilities.
* High level of ownership and accountability.
* Problem\-solving and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

description:
SUMMARY

The Design Engineer – Optics is responsible for designing and developing tooling required for precision optical

manufacturing. The role includes preparing manufacturing tool drawings, supporting production with appropriate

tooling solutions, coordinating with vendors, maintaining tooling and raw material inventory, and ensuring timely

availability of tools to achieve production and quality objectives.

EDUCATION

Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech.) in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Production Engineering,

Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

AutoCAD 2D

SolidWorks

MS Office

Engineering Drawing Interpretation

GD\&T (Preferred)

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Design Engineer – Optics Department: Precision Optics Location: Bangalore Reports To: Assistant General

Manager – Precision Optics Grade/Level: Engineer

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Tool Design \& Development: \- Design and develop tooling drawings based on optical component specifications. \-

Prepare manufacturing drawings for conventional and high\-speed optical processing machines. \- Coordinate with the

AGM and production team to finalize tooling requirements. \- Modify existing tool designs to improve productivity,

quality, and tool life.

Production Support: \- Provide suitable tooling to the production team as per manufacturing requirements. \- Resolve

tooling\-related issues during production. \- Support new product development by designing customized tooling

solutions. \- Ensure tools are available before production starts.

Vendor \& Quality Coordination: \- Inspect and verify tools received from suppliers against design specifications. \-

Coordinate with vendors for tool modifications and rework, when required. \- Maintain quality records of incoming

tools. \- Report tool quality issues and corrective actions to the AGM.

Inventory Management: \- Maintain inventory of optical tools, raw materials, consumables, and fixtures. \- Monitor

stock levels and initiate procurement requests when required. \- Maintain updated records of tooling, consumables, and

raw material availability.

Documentation: \- Maintain tool drawings and revision history. \- Prepare documentation related to tool design,

inspection, and inventory. \- Ensure proper filing of engineering drawings and manufacturing records.

Continuous Improvement: \- Recommend improvements in tooling design and manufacturing processes. \- Participate in

cost reduction and productivity improvement initiatives. \- Support implementation of standard engineering practices.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)

\- Timely preparation of tooling drawings. \- On\-time availability of production tools. \- Tool acceptance rate without

rework. \- Reduction in tooling\-related production delays. \- Accuracy and maintenance of tool inventory records. \-

Timely procurement of tooling and consumables. \- Improvement in manufacturing efficiency through optimized

tooling.

AUTHORITY

\- Prepare and release tooling drawings after approval. \- Recommend tooling modifications and improvements. \-

Coordinate with vendors regarding tooling requirements. \- Raise material and tooling requisitions.

INTERNAL \& EXTERNAL INTERACTIONS

Internal: \- AGM – Precision Optics \- Production Department \- Quality Assurance \- Purchase Department \- Stores \-

Planning Department

External: \- Tool manufacturers \- Raw material suppliers \- Approved vendors

EXPERIENCE

\- 0–1 years of experience in tool design, manufacturing engineering, or precision optics. \- Freshers with strong

SolidWorks skills may also be considered.

BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIE

\- Planning and organizing \- Teamwork and collaboration \- Effective communication \- Initiative and continuous learning

About DHL Blue Dart Express India:


Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


Position Overview:


The Ops Staff is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


Job Purpose:


To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


Key Roles \& Responsibilities:


Shipment Processing \& Operations

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.


Data Entry \& Operational Documentation

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.


Operational Support

* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.


Safety, Security \& Compliance

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.


Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.


Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


Qualifications \& Experience:


Education:

* Minimum 10th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:

* Fresher or up to 2 years of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.


Eligibility Requirements:

* Minimum age 18 years.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


Skills \& Capabilities:


Technical Skills:

* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding


Key Competencies:

* Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


Key Performance Indicators:


KRAs KPIs


Operational Productivity Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence


Quality \& Accuracy Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy


Safety \& Compliance SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations


Operational Discipline Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline


Teamwork \& Operational Support Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning


Why join DHL Blue Dart?


When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

**Company Overview**

ICA Edu Skills Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's premier vocational training and skill development institutes, specialized in accounts, finance, taxation, and digital skills. We are dedicated to bridging the gap between education and employment by delivering job\-guaranteed courses and securing meaningful career starts for our students.

* **Position Title:** Area Placement Manager / Placement Manager

* **Track 3\-month employment retention** by conducting post\-placement check\-ins with both corporate clients and placed alumni.

**4\. Team Leadership \& Strategy**

* **Manage a localized team** of placement executives, setting clear monthly sourcing and placement goals.
* **Travel across North India** (including Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, and UP) to support franchise networks with local hiring drives.

Position Overview:
The Ops Staff is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.
The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.
Job Purpose:
To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.  

Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
Shipment Processing \& Operations* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

  

Data Entry \& Operational Documentation* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

  

Operational Support* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

  

Safety, Security \& Compliance* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

  

Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

  

Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.

  

Qualifications \& Experience:
Education:* Minimum 10th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

  

Experience:* Fresher or up to 2 years of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

  

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.

  

Skills \& Capabilities:
Technical Skills:* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

  

Key Competencies:* Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


Key Performance Indicators:  

KRAs KPIs
Operational Productivity Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence
Quality \& Accuracy Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy
Safety \& Compliance SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations
Operational Discipline Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline
Teamwork \& Operational Support Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning  

Why join DHL Blue Dart?
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.

* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.

* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Report discrepancies immediately.

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.

* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

title: Software Development Engineer - I
description:
**About GoKwik**
 GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, powering merchants across checkout optimisation, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post\-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables 15,000\+ merchants globally, processes \~$2 billion in GMV, and is rapidly scaling across India, the UK, Europe, and the US. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments, GoKwik has raised $68 million in funding, including a $13 million growth round in June 2025, and is building AI\-powered infrastructure to shape the future of eCommerce.
   

  

 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer \- I, you'll build the backend systems that power millions of eCommerce transactions and experiences. From checkout and payments to RTO reduction and merchant\-facing products, you'll write production\-grade code, ship customer\-facing features, and work alongside experienced engineers to build scalable, reliable systems. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership early while developing deep technical expertise in distributed systems and modern backend engineering.
   

  

 What You'll Own
   

  

* Build, maintain, and optimize backend services using Node.js and NestJS, with exposure to Go as part of the engineering stack.
* Develop scalable APIs and backend systems using PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
* Contribute to event\-driven architectures using Kafka and collaborate with senior engineers on distributed systems.
* Ship end\-to\-end features, including frontend contributions using React and Svelte when required.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code while participating in peer code reviews.
* Debug production issues, identify root causes, and implement long\-term solutions.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and deployments on AWS.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to deliver high\-quality product experiences.


 Who You Are
   

  

* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and problem\-solving fundamentals.
* Hands\-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Exposure to Go, Redis, or Kafka is an advantage.
* Comfortable contributing across the stack, including frontend technologies like React or Svelte.
* Curious, proactive, and eager to learn while taking ownership of engineering challenges.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.


 Why GoKwik
   

  

 At GoKwik, you'll build products that power thousands of merchants and millions of shoppers while working with a high\-calibre engineering team. You'll gain exposure to modern technologies, solve complex scaling challenges, and take ownership of meaningful projects from day one. If you're excited about building high\-impact systems in a fast\-moving environment, GoKwik offers the platform to accelerate your engineering career.

As a pioneer in the art of responsible hospitality, the Accor Group gathers more than 45 brands, 5,600 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and lifestyle destinations in 110 countries. While each brand has its own personality, where you will be able to truly find yourself, they all share a common ambition: to keep innovating and challenging the status\-quo.


By joining us, you will become a Heartist®, because hospitality is, first and foremost, a work of heart.


You will join a caring environment and a team where you can be all you are. You will be in a supportive place to grow, to fulfil yourself, to discover other professions and to pursue career opportunities, in your hotel or in other hospitality environments, in your country or anywhere in the world!


You will enjoy exclusive benefits, specific to the sector and beyond, as well as strong recognition for your daily commitment.


Everything you will do with us, regardless of your profession, will offer a deep sense of meaning, to create lasting, memorable and impactful experiences for your customers, for your colleagues and for the planet.

 **Job Description**  

This position is responsible to oversee and manage the learning and development process for all talent in the hotel. This position will ensure that all learning activities support Accor philosophy of creating an environment where each and every member of the team is recognized as talent and feels valued for their contribution.

* Develop, implement, and oversee the annual training plan and learning budget, ensuring strategic alignment with organizational goals and efficient resource allocation
* Conduct comprehensive Training Needs Analysis in collaboration with department heads and stakeholders to identify skill gaps and design targeted learning solutions
* Design, coordinate, and deliver engaging training programs—both internal and external—across all organizational levels, utilizing diverse delivery methods and platforms

description:
**Intern: Procurement \& Resource Development**

**Place of Posting: Purnea, BIhar**

**About Company:**

AgroKisan, a brand owned by Krishi Samriddhi Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an innovative Agritech startups, leveraging cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize agriculture in India. AgroKisan focus on precision farming, agriculture value chain, and sustainable solutions for efficiency and resilience in agricultural sector. With a commitment to modernizing practices, AgroKisan play a vital role in shaping a more sustainable and productive future for Indian Agriculture Ecosystem. We are supported by Govt. of Bihar and incubated under Indian Institute of Technology, Patna.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Intern to join our Agribusiness team. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in various aspects of agricultural industry. This role offers exposure to a fast\-paced and innovative environment where you will work closely with our sales and marketing professionals to support our business objectives.

**Role Overview**

The Intern – Procurement (Agri Commodity) \& Resource Development will be responsible for sourcing agricultural commodities, managing field\-level procurement operations, and developing a strong network of farmers, FPOs, vendors, and field resources. The role ensures high\-quality, cost\-effective procurement while building sustainable relationships across the agriculture value chain. It also involves developing and training field partners, enabling efficient supply aggregation, and strengthening resource planning for ongoing agritech operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Agri Commodity Procurement**

* Identify and onboard farmers, FPOs/FPCs, aggregators, and traders for commodity sourcing.
* Conduct market research to track commodity prices, demand patterns, and seasonal availability.
* Negotiate procurement terms, quality parameters, and logistics with suppliers.
* Ensure timely procurement of commodities such as fruits, vegetables, grains, spices, pulses, or any crop aligned with company operations.
* Coordinate quality checks during procurement and ensure adherence to grading and standard specifications.
* Support contract farming or buy\-back arrangements with growers where applicable.

**2\. Field Resource Development \& Network Expansion**

* Develop a robust field network including farmers, FPOs, community leaders, agri\-input dealers, and rural micro\-entrepreneurs.
* Train and support field partners on procurement processes, quality parameters, and digital reporting tools.
* Conduct field visits to assess crop readiness, farmer engagement, and resource availability.
* Build a database of field resources to support sourcing, aggregation, and logistics operations.
* Identify new sourcing clusters and build market linkages in potential agri\-growing regions.

**3\. Supply Chain \& Operational Support**

* Coordinate logistics, transportation, and last\-mile pickup from sourcing locations to warehouses or processing centers.
* Work closely with operations and quality teams to ensure a seamless procurement\-to\-delivery pipeline.
* Assist in planning procurement volumes based on demand forecasts and operational needs.
* Ensure minimal wastage, efficient handling, and cost\-effective aggregation.

**4\. Stakeholder \& Vendor Relationship Management**

* Maintain strong relationships with suppliers, farmers, FPO leaders, and local market stakeholders.
* Conduct periodic supplier evaluations based on quality, reliability, and pricing.
* Resolve field\-level issues related to quality disputes, procurement delays, or logistics challenges.
* Collaborate with government agencies, NGOs, or agri institutions for field\-level resource development.

**5\. Resource Planning, Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain updated records of procurement volumes, sourcing locations, farmer databases, vendor details, and field activities.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly reports on procurement performance, price trends, and field resource development.
* Ensure documentation compliance including purchase orders, agreements, receipts, and quality reports.
* Use digital tools or ERP systems to log procurement and field data accurately.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s/Master degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Rural Development, Supply Chain, or related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Agribusiness or Rural Management preferred.

**Work Experience**

* Freshers can also apply
* Prior experience in agri commodity procurement, field sourcing, supply chain, or rural operations will be prefered.
* Experience working with farmers, FPOs, mandi operations, rural networks, or agritech companies is highly desirable.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong understanding of agri commodities, market dynamics, crop cycles, and quality standards.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and vendor management skills.
* Ability to build rapport with farmers and rural stakeholders.
* Knowledge of mandi operations, auction systems, and procurement compliance.
* Good analytical and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, procurement tools, and mobile\-based field reporting apps.
* Willingness to travel extensively to sourcing clusters.

**Key Personal Attributes**

* Field\-focused attitude with problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong interpersonal skills with empathy toward farmers and rural communities.
* Proactive, reliable, and able to work independently.
* Ability to handle pressure and dynamic procurement requirements.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work at the intersection of agriculture, technology, and supply chain innovation.
* Hands\-on exposure to emerging agritech business models.
* Career growth in procurement, rural operations, and supplier development.
* Direct impact on farmer livelihoods and sustainable sourcing.

Interested Candidate may send thier cv at hr@agrokisan.com

HR Services Department India, Chennai, India
   

  

 Our Graduate Programme in Chennai, India offers a unique opportunity to begin your professional journey while gaining practical experience in a collaborative and fast\-paced HR environment. If you've just completed your degree and are eager to develop your skills and build a strong foundation for your career, our Graduate Programme is the ideal opportunity for you.
   

  

 We offer our graduates rewarding career opportunities within our HR Services team, where they can learn, grow, and contribute to a performance\-driven culture. The Graduate Programme provides graduates with the opportunity to gain exposure to key HR processes and support functions, helping them build a solid understanding of HR operations and shared services.
   

  

 Working alongside experienced professionals, graduates will develop practical skills while taking on meaningful responsibilities that contribute to day\-to\-day HR operations. Additionally, participants will have access to training programmes covering essential HR processes, business communication, professional etiquette, collaboration, and other core workplace skills.
   

  

 All graduates will be assigned mentors who will guide them throughout their development journey at Glencore. The mentoring programme will help new joiners understand our company culture, develop professionally, and build relationships across the HR Services team.
   

  

**Global HR Hub \& Payroll Services Graduate Programme**
 We are seeking a detail\-orientated, proactive, and highly motivated Graduate to be part of the Global HR Services team in Chennai, India, through the HR Hub which supports key operational processes for multiple Glencore offices worldwide.
   

  

 Global HR \& Payroll Services Graduate Programme is designed to prove your aptitude and test your resilience providing functional support to HR Services and Payroll, with opportunities to rotate between.
   

  

 The HR graduate will work in a shared service centre environment (our HR Hub) and the required attributes include strong organizational skills, a customer\-focused mindset, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, globally matrixed environment and gain exposure to international HR operations and best practice and contribute to impactful employee experiences across the globe.
   

  

 We are looking for students who are currently enrolled in or have recently graduated with a Bachelor of Commerce degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related study is beneficial.

 Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life.
   

  

 With over 140,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices.
   

  

 Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

description:
Overview:

The Senior Implementation Consultant is a trusted advisor responsible for leading customers through the successful implementation, configuration, and early adoption of iCIMS solutions. This role partners closely with customer stakeholders to understand business objectives, provide strategic consultation, recommend best practices, and ensure successful deployment aligned with organizational hiring goals.


As a senior individual contributor, the consultant leads complex customer engagements, mentors team members, resolves implementation challenges, and drives successful project outcomes while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.


About Us:

ICIMS is a leading enterprise hiring platform that combines the scale and reliability of enterprise software with the transformative power of AI. Thousands of organizations across more than 200 countries and territories trust ICIMS to find and hire the people who shape their future and drive their business forward. Powered by insights from billions of hiring interactions, continuous AI innovation, and a highly extensible platform, ICIMS helps organizations turn talent acquisition into a competitive advantage. For more than 25 years, ICIMS has delivered end\-to\-end hiring solutions that improve recruiting efficiency, reduce costs and create exceptional candidate experiences.  

ICIMS helps solve one of the biggest challenges businesses face today: building a workforce that can adapt, scale, and perform in an increasingly competitive and unpredictable talent market. We uniquely do that by combining enterprise\-grade hiring technology, AI\-powered insights and automation, and connected talent experiences to help organizations improve hiring outcomes while driving measurable impact.
Responsibilities:
**Customer Consulting \& Solution Design**

* Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer business processes, requirements, and goals.
* Recommend solution designs and configuration strategies that align with iCIMS best practices.
* Guide customers through process optimization and change management considerations.

**Project Delivery \& Implementation Leadership**

* Lead complex implementation engagements from project kick\-off through go live.
* Drive requirements gathering, solution design validation, configuration reviews, testing, training, and deployment activities.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks while proactively developing mitigation plans.
* Ensure projects remain aligned to scope, timelines, and customer expectations.

**Solution Configuration \& Product Expertise**

* Configure and optimize iCIMS products to support customer requirements.
* Act as a product subject matter expert across assigned solution areas.
* Validate system readiness and support user acceptance testing activities.
* Troubleshoot complex configuration and process\-related issues.

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Build strong relationships with project sponsors, business stakeholders, and system administrators.
* Act as the primary implementation consultant and strategic partner for customers.
* Provide ongoing consultation and recommendations to maximize platform value.
* Translate complex technical concepts into business\-friendly language.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Project Managers, Integration Consultants, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, and other internal teams.
* Coordinate resources and activities required for successful project delivery.
* Support escalations and facilitate resolution of customer concerns.
* Contribute to seamless transitions during go\-live and post\-implementation handoffs.

**Mentorship \& Continuous Improvement**

* Mentor and coach Implementation Consultants and Associate Consultants.
* Share best practices, implementation methodologies, and customer success strategies.
* Contribute to process improvements, documentation standards, playbooks, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Participate in strategic initiatives that improve delivery quality and operational efficiency.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor's degree with equivalent professional experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, consulting, professional services, HR technology, or enterprise software deployment.
* Experience leading customer\-facing projects and managing multiple priorities.
* Strong consultative, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience facilitating customer workshops, discovery sessions, and executive discussions.

Preferred:

* Experience working in global and cross\-functional environments.

Vous travaillerez avec des collègues dynamiques – des experts dans leurs domaines – qui sont désireux de partager leurs connaissances avec vous. Vos leaders vous inspireront et vous aideront à atteindre votre potentiel et à vous envoler vers de nouveaux horizons. Chaque jour, vous aurez de nouvelles et passionnantes occasions de rendre la vie plus brillante pour nos Clients – qui sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.  



  

Chez Sun Life, nous sommes guidés par notre Raison d'être : aider nos Clients à réaliser la sécurité financière à vie et à vivre une vie plus saine. Nos valeurs façonnent notre façon de travailler : bienveillance, authenticité, audace, inspiration et impact.  



  

Quand vous vous joignez à Sun Life, vous travaillez avec des collègues passionnés et des leaders habilitants qui soutiennent votre croissance et célèbrent vos contributions, afin que vous puissiez faire une différence significative dans la vie de nos Clients.  



  

Découvrez comment vous pouvez faire une différence dans la vie des personnes, des familles et des communautés du monde entier.  



  

**De** **scription de** **poste** **:**

**The Opportunity**

Global Procurement \& Payment (GPP) function at Sun Life is establishing a Global Vendor Relationship team as a result of continuously forming strategic relationship with key vendors and monitoring the risks related to vendors. This is to ensure compliance to regulatory requirements on vendor management and strengthen Sun Life’s strategic partnerships.


This role is to manage medium risk and high spend categories across Sun Life to cover key vendors in categories, such as Medical Operations, Business Operations, HR, etc.


This role reports to Sr Manager, Global Procurement \& Payment.


**What you will do:**

* **Relationship Management:** Act as a key liaison between internal teams and external vendors to foster collaborative partnerships. Understand business needs and develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders (legal, risk, finance, etc.) Collaborate with GPP Category \& Sourcing.
* **Data collection, dashboarding and reporting** : Collect various data elements but not limited to service overviews, Spend, Contract renewal and expiry, Contractual obligation requirements, surveys, external market data events, risk for holistic view on Vendor performance.
* **Financial \& Cost Management:** Monitor invoice alignment to contract, ensure service credits are received/applied.
* **Contract Lifecycle Management:** Managing contract renewals including Master, and terminations, ensuring compliance with Sun Life Standards .
* **Risk \& Compliance:** Identify and mitigate operational risks associated with third\-party providers, ensuring compliance with policies.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify opportunities to optimize vendor services, enhance efficiency, and reduce costs by leveraging including but not limited to data, stakeholder feedback and external sources.

**What you will need to succeed:**

* Relevant Industry Experience: A background in IT Software, IT infrastructure, Finance/Insurance Operations is preferred.
* Supplier \& Stakeholder Relationship Management: Exceptional interpersonal skills to build and maintain trust\-based relationships with both our vendors and internal stakeholders, fostering collaboration, alignment, and continuous improvement.
* Contract Management Expertise: Demonstrable post\-deal contract management experience, including ensuring adherence to contract terms and managing a portfolio of contracts renewal.
* Risk \& Compliance Management: Experience identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks while ensuring compliance with legal, risk, information security and other standards.
* Analytical and Problem\-Solving Skills: A proven ability to interpret data, identify trends, and resolve issues to improve performance and enhance supplier efficiency.
* Commercial Acumen: Proven ability to deliver cost efficiency and added value from contract management, with a sound understanding of financial and business principles.
* **Communication:** Solid communication skills (Verbal \& written) and experience working with global counterparts in North America and Asia.
* Mindset of Continuous Improvement.

**Job Qualifications:**

* **6 years** \+ relevant experience in vendor management and/or procurement , supplier contracting, risk assessment, information security review process is required.
* Project Management skills
* Clear, concise, and influential verbal and written communication skills are required
* Strong problem solving skills required
* University or college degree in Business Management, Economics, Finance, IT, or a related field; MBA is a plus.

title: Group Human Resources Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced and dependable Human Resources Manager to oversee the complete employee lifecycle, with a strong focus on recruitment, employee performance, disciplinary matters, and terminations.

The successful candidate will be responsible for hiring qualified employees, supporting management with staffing decisions, handling sensitive workplace matters professionally, and ensuring all HR actions comply with applicable employment laws and company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

* Manage the complete recruitment process, including creating job postings, screening applications, conducting interviews, checking references, and preparing employment offers.
* Work with management to identify staffing requirements and hire suitable candidates for office, sales, warehouse, and operational positions.
* Coordinate employee onboarding, orientation, employment documentation, and probationary\-period reviews.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records, contracts, attendance information, warnings, and performance documentation.
* Develop and maintain workplace policies, employee handbooks, job descriptions, and HR procedures.
* Monitor employee attendance, conduct, productivity, and workplace performance.
* Support managers in addressing performance concerns, employee complaints, workplace conflicts, and disciplinary matters.
* Prepare written warnings, performance improvement plans, and other disciplinary documentation.
* Manage employee terminations professionally, including documentation, termination meetings, final\-pay coordination, and return of company property.
* Ensure hiring, discipline, layoffs, and terminations comply with applicable employment standards, human rights requirements, and company policies.
* Conduct workplace investigations and document findings when necessary.
* Assist with compensation reviews, vacation tracking, benefits administration, payroll information, and employee leave requests.
* Promote a respectful, productive, and professional workplace culture.

Qualifications:

* Diploma or degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Previous experience in an HR Manager, HR Generalist, or similar position.
* Strong experience with recruitment, employee relations, performance management, discipline, and termination procedures.
* Good understanding of applicable employment laws and workplace regulations.
* Excellent communication, interviewing, conflict\-resolution, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Comfortable making difficult and fair employment decisions when required.

The ideal candidate will be confident, organized, fair, and capable of managing sensitive employee matters independently while protecting both the company and its employees.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Junior HR Associate
description:
**About Us:**


**Fresh Prints** is a New York\-based custom apparel startup. We work with talented student entrepreneurs and provide the working capital, training, and support they need to build businesses at their schools.



At most companies, recruiting is about filling open roles. At Fresh Prints, recruiting is about building the teams that determine where the company goes next. Every hire shapes how fast we grow, how well our teams perform, and what we're capable of building. That's why we don't see Talent Acquisition as a support function. We see it as a strategic capability that directly influences the business.



This role goes far beyond posting jobs and coordinating interviews. We're looking for someone who enjoys building pipelines before they're needed, questioning existing processes, and finding smarter ways to help great people discover Fresh Prints.


**Role Overview**



As a Jr. HR Associate at Fresh Prints, you will support talent acquisition efforts across multiple roles. You'll work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates to help deliver a seamless hiring experience from sourcing through hiring. This role is ideal for someone who is detail\-oriented, proactive, highly organized, and eager to build a career in recruitment and people operations.


**Key Responsibilities**



As a member of our Recruitment team, you're going to have a wide\-ranging group of responsibilities and goals. On a day\-to\-day basis, this means:


* Lead prospecting and headhunting efforts. Not just finding the right candidates, but nurturing relationships early and building long\-term pipelines.
* Source candidates from diverse channels and screen resumes and applications with a strong quality bar.
* Take hands\-on ownership of role coordination that goes beyond scheduling (much of which is automated) to stay closely involved in progress, blockers, and outcomes for each role.
* Conduct interviews and coordinate multiple rounds of assessments.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to align on role expectations, feedback, and hiring timelines.
* Communicate clearly with management and team members to provide regular status updates.
* Develop search strategies to identify and attract top talent.
* Take ownership of recruitment\-related projects and additional responsibilities as needed.


**Requirements**


* Preferably 1\.5\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment
* Fresh graduates of Human Resources or Psychology are highly encouraged to apply
* Strong attention to detail with relentless follow\-up
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Experience in a start\-up environment is a huge plus
* Strong internship experience in HR or Recruitment is highly preferred.
* Experience in a startup environment or in\-house recruitment is a plus.
* Experience working in a remote environment is preferred.


**Compensation \& Benefits**


* **Monthly Salary:** Between $400 to $550, with a night allowance of $40

**Location \& Timings**


* **Full\-time remote** role starting as soon as the right candidate is found.
* **Working Hours:** 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday

title: HR Executive/Sr. HR Executive
description:
**Location:** Bangalore (Occasional travel to Madikeri/Coorg)

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and people\-oriented **HR Executive** to support the company's day\-to\-day human resource activities across recruitment, employee onboarding, documentation, attendance \& payroll, and employee engagement.

The role is for an individual who enjoys interacting with people, maintains confidentiality, and follows SOPs with discipline.

**Areas of Focus**

* Recruitment \& Onboarding
* Employee Documentation
* Attendance, Leave \& Payroll
* Employee Engagement
* Statutory Compliance Support

**Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Onboarding**

* Coordinate end\-to\-end recruitment activities including job postings, candidate sourcing, interview scheduling, follow\-ups, and joining formalities.
* Coordinate with department managers to understand hiring requirements and ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Conduct employee onboarding, induction, and orientation to help new employees settle into the organization.

**Employee Documentation**

* Prepare offer and appointment letters, and maintain all employment records and HR\-related documents accurately and on time.
* Maintain employee documentation in accordance with company policies and procedures.

**Attendance, Leave \& Payroll**

* Track employee attendance and leave records, maintain related HR data, and prepare monthly payroll inputs.
* Support statutory compliance activities as needed.

**Employee Engagement**

* Assist in implementing employee engagement initiatives, training programmes, and company events.
* Coordinate probation reviews, performance reviews (PIP), and exit formalities.

**HR Operations \& Reporting**

* Maintain HR trackers, MIS, and recruitment reports, ensuring timely and accurate reporting.
* Support overall HR operations by coordinating with internal stakeholders and ensuring smooth execution of HR processes.

**Travel Requirement**

Terrain Estates also operates a resort in **Madikeri (Coorg)**. The role will require occasional travel to support HR activities and engage with employees at the resort.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Pleasant and well\-groomed, professionally smart personality to be able to interact with all types of employees.
* Good communication skills (spoken and written); prompt in responding.
* Demonstrates discipline, professionalism, and a positive attitude in day\-to\-day work.
* Good planning, coordination, and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to handle confidential information with maturity and integrity.
* Good working knowledge of **MS Office**, especially **Excel** and **Word**.
* Exposure to **HRMS**.

**Desired Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree or **MBA in HR**.
* Minimum **3 years** of experience in HR; well versed in Recruitment \& Payroll data preparation.
* Preferred industry experience: **Real Estate, Hospitality, Non\-IT SMEs**.
* Languages: **Kannada and English are mandatory**; **Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu** will be an advantage.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹43,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
