title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Company Name: Fabhotels  

Industry: Hospitality
Seniority level: Associate level  



Experience: 3\+ yrs



Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India



Job Type: Full\-time



**About the role**
------------------


* Manage the full recruitment life cycle sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing candidates across levels and functions \- Non IT Hiring
* Partner with hiring managers and business heads to understand role requirements, organizational structure, and business priorities.
* Build effective sourcing strategies using job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, and networking.
* Drive proactive talent mapping and pipeline building for critical and niche roles.
* Ensure a strong employer brand presence through social media and candidate engagement initiatives.
* Conduct HR discussions, negotiate offers, and ensure seamless onboarding coordination.
* Maintain and update recruitment dashboards, metrics, and reports for leadership visibility.
* Manage vendor relationships (if applicable) and ensure adherence to hiring budgets and timelines.
* Champion diversity hiring and inclusion initiatives across all business functions.
  


Required Skills \& Qualifications:


* 3\-5 years of experience in end\-to\-end recruitment (corporate or agency background).
* Proven success in hiring for mid to senior\-level roles across business, tech, or support functions.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong understanding of recruitment tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, ATS systems, etc.).
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to track, analyze, and report key hiring metrics.
* Self\-driven, high ownership, and ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Leveraged AI Tools for Screening and recruitment processes
  


Preferred Qualifications:


* MBA / PGDM in HR or equivalent or Ba \- English Hons or Psychology from good college
* Experience in a high\-growth or startup environment will be a strong plus.
  


What We Offer:


* Fast\-paced, merit\-driven environment.
* Exposure to leadership hiring and strategic HR projects.
* Opportunity to shape and scale the organizations talent strategy.
* 5 days work from office
**About the company**
---------------------


FabHotels has built India’s largest tech\-enabled budget hotel network with 1,400\+ properties across 80\+ cities. TravelPlus \- India’s largest player in the corporate travel segment offering a one\-stop solution for all corporate travel needs.
**Must\-have skills**
---------------------


non it recruitment, Recruitment
**Good\-to\-have skills**
-------------------------


Headhunting, Non Technical recruiting, leadership hiring

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Administrator - Professional Development Operations
description:
Job ID: 110741
Gurugram
Manila  


Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem\-solver who is energized by challenges? You’ve come to the right place.


YOUR IMPACT


You will support operational excellence across Asia Professional Development (PD) Operations by managing accurate data, coordinating review\-related processes, enabling timely communications, and providing reliable administrative and logistical support to PD stakeholders.


You will help ensure operational excellence across the Asian PD function by delivering accurate data and process management, seamless logistical and communication support, and reliable execution of a broad range of PD\-related operational tasks, focused on the review process support.


Your responsibilities will include executing standardized administrative support processes, organizing and managing information such as people data, and collaborating with colleagues to provide seamless support. Key tasks may involve managing committee rosters, ensuring data accuracy, tracking the completion of PD and/or review\-related documents, sending communications to evaluees and evaluators, and organizing day\-of \-review support. You will leverage your organizational and communication skills to coordinate logistics, gather relevant documents, ensure timely and effective communication, and maintain accurate data.


Based in our Manila/ Gurugram Service Center office, you will join our Asia PD Operations team supporting our Professional Development (PD) function in Asia.


You will collaborate closely with PD Managers, Specialists and Coordinators, administrators, and colleagues across the firm to support PD\-related activities for practices and/or office locations across Europe, while contributing to McKinsey's culture of continuous feedback and development.


YOUR GROWTH


You are someone who thrives in a high\-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.


In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well\-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.


When you join us, you will have:

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS


Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience is required


1\+ years of professional experience in HR, Talent or Professional development operations


Able to work efficiently and effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment


Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy when handling information and following established processes


Strong technical skills, including proficiency in Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. Specific experience with excel is preferred


Outstanding organizational skills; detail\-oriented; able to prioritize and multitask; strong ownership evident through responsibility and accountability for product; highly proactive mindset


Demonstrates good judgment and knows when to seek guidance


Ability to work in\-person at the Manila or Gurugram Service Center for a minimum of two days a week, with the flexibility to work from other office or non\-office settings and travel to less accessible environments as team schedules or business needs require (excluding legally exempt circumstances)


Strong communication skills in English; both verbal and written

title: S4C - Training coordinator
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**


As a **Training Coordinator**, you will help plan, organise, and deliver training activities as part of our SAP S/4HANA transformation programme. You'll work closely with subject matter experts (SMEs), trainers, and business teams to ensure employees have the knowledge and support they need before and after system go\-live.


This is a hands\-on role ideal for someone who enjoys coordinating activities, creating training content, working with different stakeholders, and keeping projects on track.

**About Role**

**Training Coordination**

* Help plan and schedule training activities.
* Organise training sessions across multiple teams and locations.
* Manage training calendars, meeting invites, and logistics.
* Coordinate with trainers, SMEs, and stakeholders to ensure training runs smoothly.

**Training Content \& Materials**

* Assist in creating and updating training materials, presentations, user guides, and quick reference guides.
* Work with business experts to turn complex processes into easy\-to\-understand training content.
* Ensure training materials are clear, consistent, and up to date.
* Gather feedback from training participants and help improve future sessions.
* Support refresher and follow\-up training after go\-live.

**Tracking \& Reporting**

* Monitor training attendance and completion rates.
* Maintain training trackers and dashboards.
* Provide regular updates on training progress.
* Identify and raise potential issues early, such as low attendance or training gaps.
* Support user readiness activities with training data and insights.

**Stakeholder Support**

* Work closely with the Organizational Change Management (OCM) team to understand training needs.
* Communicate training schedules, updates, and expectations to different audiences.
* Help ensure employees are ready and confident to use new SAP processes and systems.
**IMPORTANT: WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**

*This is not a leadership or management position. We are not looking for an OCM Lead, Manager, or someone whose experience is primarily in strategy, governance, or team management. This role is focused on execution and coordination. We’re looking for someone who can manage training schedules, support content creation, ensure sessions run smoothly, and keep the programme on track.*

***NOTE:*** *Supporting EU/US timezones: flexibility around work hours is to be expected*

**About you**

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Experience supporting or coordinating training activities on an SAP S/4HANA project.
* Experience using **SAP Enable Now** to create or maintain training materials.
* Strong organisational and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working with stakeholders across different teams and levels.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and able to work independently.
**Nice to Have**

* Experience supporting SAP transformation projects in Healthcare, MedTech, or Pharmaceutical organisations.
* Knowledge of role\-based training or train\-the\-trainer approaches.
* Exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, HR, or other business process transformation programmes.
* Experience supporting large\-scale system implementations.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


People Analytics \& Insights (PAI) team is part of Human Resource Department. This team is equipped to assist our clients with quick insights, dashboards, reporting resources and guides that will help deliver actionable insights and transform how the firm leverages human capital data which in turn helps in data driven decision making.


Reporting Solutions Analyst role is primarily focused on reporting and data management. This role is part of Reporting Solutions which is an integral part of People Analytics \& Insights team. Role will require specialty area knowledge in monitoring, assessing, analyzing and/or evaluating processes and data. Interpreting data and making recommendations. Identifying inconsistencies in data or results, defining business issues and formulate recommendations on policies, procedures or practices. Role demands to have good understanding of how the team interacts with others in accomplishing the objectives of the area.


Responsibilities:


* This function covers incumbents responsible for various data activities, which includes data analysis, maintenance, data quality, and database management.
* Develop, Maintain, and Deliver recurring and ad\-hoc reports, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timelines.
* Following Internal Processes like following SOPs for report preparation, updating internal trackers, following maker checker process etc.
* Partnering internally within PAI team members to understand reporting needs and provide effective data solutions.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Handling sensitive data with the highest level of care, ensuring strict adherence to processes, data privacy standards, and organizational guidelines when sharing information with clients and stakeholders.
* Performing Dashboard Validations in Tableau and collaborating with PAI Data Science team to validate and test HR dashboards for accuracy, usability and business relevance.
* Focusing on continuous improvement and proactively identifying opportunities to streamline reporting processes, enhance data visualization and improve the overall reporting experience
* Creating and Maintaining clear documentation for reporting processes, methodologies, and data definitions to ensure consistency and transparency.
* Equipping yourself with a thorough understanding of existing tableau dashboards/ products to effectively interpret, validate and enhance reporting solutions.

  

Qualifications:


* Min 3 – 5 years of experience in handling data in a corporate environment, HR Data \& Reporting experience is a plus.
* Intermediate expertise in Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel (formulas, pivot, tables, data analysis, conditional formatting etc.) \& PowerPoint (presentation building).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey data insights clearly.
* Working knowledge of Business Intelligence (BI) tools ( e.g. – Tableau) or SharePoint site is an added advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
* A proactive, “go\-to” attitude with the ability to take initiative and work independently.

Education:


* Min Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience

Every role follows a structured onboarding and development pathway designed to build confidence, strengthen operational knowledge, and prepare individuals for success in a live support environment.  

  



**What You'll Be Doing**


* Design, develop, and maintain engaging learning materials for onboarding, upskilling, and continuous learning programs.
* Create instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, self\-paced, and blended learning content using instructional design best practices.

* Continuously review and update learning content based on operational feedback, quality insights, learner performance, and business requirements.
* Maintain version control and governance across learning documentation, job aids, facilitator guides, participant materials, and knowledge repositories.
* Evaluate learning effectiveness through learner feedback, assessment results, and operational performance metrics to recommend improvements.
* Ensure learning content aligns with adult learning principles and supports different learning styles.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance learner engagement, knowledge retention, and operational readiness.

----------------

* **2–3 years of experience in an Instructional Designer, Learning Content Developer, or similar Learning \& Development role**.
* **Experience designing learning solutions within Customer Support, Player Support, Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Gaming**, or similar operational environments is preferred.
* Strong understanding of instructional design methodologies and adult learning principles.
* **Relevant certifications in Instructional Design, eLearning development, or adult learning methodologies** are an advantage.
* Excellent written communication, content writing, and information structuring skills.
* Ability to simplify complex operational concepts into engaging and easy\-to\-understand learning experiences.
* Experience developing instructor\-led, e\-learning, self\-paced, and blended learning programs.
* Experience creating assessments, quizzes, facilitator guides, learner guides, job aids, and knowledge documentation.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across Operations, Training, Quality, and Program teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, SharePoint, Confluence, and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* **Experience using instructional authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond**, or similar platforms is desirable.

title: Embedded Software Design Engineer
description:
Embedded Software Design Engineer:

We are looking for a passionate Embedded Software Design Engineer (fresher to 3 years of experience) to join our software team. You will develop firmware, device drivers, board support packages and application software for our GNSS receivers, time synchronization systems, antenna control units and rugged computing products, working closely with the hardware team from board bring\-up to field deployment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop firmware in Embedded C/C\+\+ for ARM Cortex\-M/Cortex\-A based microcontrollers and SoCs.
* Develop and port Board Support Packages (BSP), bootloaders (U\-Boot) and device drivers on Embedded Linux and RTOS platforms (FreeRTOS or equivalent).
* Implement drivers and application software for peripherals and interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, USB, RS\-232/422/485 and GPIO.
* Develop and integrate communication protocols including TCP/IP, UDP, NTP/PTP time synchronization and NMEA/GNSS message parsing.
* Support board bring\-up of new hardware — flashing, debugging and validating processor, memory and peripheral functionality along with the hardware team.
* Implement algorithms for navigation, tracking and control applications in coordination with senior engineers.
* Write test code, perform unit and integration testing, and support environmental/EMI qualification test cycles.
* Debug issues at the hardware\-software boundary using JTAG debuggers, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
* Prepare software design documents, test reports and user documentation.

**Required Skills:** 

* Strong programming fundamentals in C (and preferably C\+\+), data structures and memory management.
* Good understanding of microcontroller/microprocessor architecture, interrupts, timers, DMA and peripheral interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN).
* Basic knowledge of Embedded Linux or any RTOS concepts (tasks, scheduling, semaphores, queues).
* Familiarity with development tools: GCC toolchains, Makefiles, Git, JTAG/SWD debuggers.
* Ability to read schematics and datasheets and work closely with hardware engineers.
* Good analytical, debugging and documentation skills.
* For experienced candidates (1–3 yrs): hands\-on project experience in firmware/driver/BSP development is expected.

**Preferred / Added Advantage:**

* Academic or project exposure to GNSS/GPS, navigation, SATCOM or communication systems.
* Knowledge of Linux kernel/device driver development or Yocto build systems.
* Exposure to networking protocols (TCP/IP stack, NTP/PTP) or socket programming.
* Scripting knowledge (Python/Shell) for test automation.
* Familiarity with defense/aerospace software practices and documentation.

**What We Offer:** 

* Hands\-on exposure to complete product development — firmware to field deployment — on mission\-critical defense and aerospace products.
* Mentorship from a core team of experienced professionals across specialized domains.
* Fast learning curve in a DeepTech environment serving leading Indian PSUs and defense organizations.

title: RTL / Verilog Design Engineer (FPGA)
description:
**RTL / Verilog Design Engineer (FPGA) :** 

We are seeking an RTL / Verilog Design Engineer (fresher to 3 years of experience) to develop FPGA\-based digital logic for our signal processing, navigation, timing and control products. You will design, simulate, verify and implement RTL for high\-pin\-count FPGAs used in GNSS receivers, beacon receivers, time servers and antenna control systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop RTL modules in Verilog/VHDL for FPGA\-based products — interface controllers, timing logic, data acquisition and signal processing blocks.
* Develop testbenches and perform functional simulation and verification of RTL designs (ModelSim/Vivado Simulator/Questa).
* Perform synthesis, place\-and\-route, timing constraint definition (SDC/XDC) and timing closure on Xilinx/Intel FPGA platforms (Vivado/Quartus).
* Implement and integrate interface logic such as UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, memory controllers (DDR), Ethernet MAC and high\-speed serial interfaces.
* Integrate and validate soft processor cores (MicroBlaze/NIOS) and IP cores, and support hardware\-software co\-design with the firmware team.
* Support FPGA board bring\-up and hardware validation using ChipScope/ILA, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
* Develop DSP blocks (filters, correlators, NCOs, mixers) for GNSS/beacon signal processing applications under guidance of senior engineers.
* Document design architecture, verification plans, test reports and release notes.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong fundamentals in digital design — combinational/sequential logic, FSMs, FIFOs, clock domain crossing and pipelining.
* Good hands\-on knowledge of Verilog (or VHDL) coding for synthesis and simulation.
* Familiarity with FPGA design flow: simulation, synthesis, implementation, constraints and timing analysis.
* Exposure to Xilinx Vivado or Intel Quartus toolchains.
* Understanding of common peripheral interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C) and memory basics.
* Ability to write testbenches and debug simulation waveforms.
* Good problem\-solving, analytical and documentation skills.
* For experienced candidates (1–3 yrs): project experience in FPGA implementation, timing closure and board\-level validation is expected.

**Preferred / Added Advantage:**

* Academic or project exposure to DSP concepts (FIR/IIR filters, FFT, correlation) or SDR/GNSS signal processing.
* Knowledge of AXI/AVALON bus protocols and SoC FPGA platforms (Zynq).
* Exposure to high\-speed interfaces (PCIe, SerDes, Gigabit Ethernet) or DDR memory controllers.
* Familiarity with SystemVerilog or UVM\-based verification.
* Scripting skills (TCL, Python) for build and test automation.

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunity to work on FPGA designs at the heart of mission\-critical defense, SATCOM and navigation products.
* Complete design\-cycle exposure — RTL to silicon\-on\-board validation and field qualification.
* Mentorship from an experienced core team in a fast\-growing DeepTech company serving leading Indian PSUs and defense organizations.

**Job Title:** Prompt Engineer (Entry\-Level / Fresher)

**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala **Job Type:** Full\-Time

**About the Role**

Are you fascinated by Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Models? We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and creative fresher to join our growing AI team as a Prompt Engineer. This is a fantastic opportunity to kickstart your career in the AI industry.

Under the mentorship of our senior engineering team, you will learn how to shape the way our AI systems interact, reason, and deliver value. You will assist in designing, testing, and refining the prompts that drive complex LLM behaviors. If you love experimenting with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini and want to turn that passion into a career building advanced AI\-native products and autonomous workflows, this role is for you!

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Prompt Design \& Optimization:** Assist in crafting, refining, and iterating on prompts to elicit specific, high\-quality responses from foundational LLMs (e.g., GPT\-4, Claude, Gemini, Llama).
* **System Integration Support:** Work alongside senior AI engineers to learn how to integrate optimized prompts into broader LLM orchestration workflows and Agentic RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
* **Evaluation \& Testing:** Help conduct rigorous A/B testing and use evaluation frameworks to measure prompt effectiveness, accuracy, and response times.
* **Workflow Automation:** Collaborate with AI Solutions Engineers to understand and support automated pipelines where AI agents solve multi\-step problems.
* **Quality \& Safety Assurance:** Review AI outputs to spot "hallucinations," identify edge cases, and ensure responses align with safety and ethical guidelines.
* **Documentation:** Help build and maintain a comprehensive internal library of prompt templates and version control histories.

**Qualifications**

* **Education:** Recent graduate (B.Tech/B.E, B.Sc, BCA, or similar) in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
* **Technical Knowledge:** A strong foundational understanding of (or eager willingness to learn) LLM orchestration frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex and Agentic RAG architectures.
* **Programming:** Basic proficiency in Python scripting and familiarity with standard data structures (JSON, XML) to interface with APIs.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Deeply logical and detail\-oriented. You enjoy troubleshooting, reverse\-engineering problems, and figuring out *why* an AI model gave a specific answer.
* **Communication:** Excellent written communication skills, with a nuanced understanding of linguistics, context, and tone.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. title: Quality Control (QC) Executive – Plate Washing Facility
description:
**Position: Quality Control (QC) Executive – Plate Washing FacilityDepartment (Night Shift)**

**Job Summary**

The Quality Control (QC) Executive is responsible for ensuring that all cleaned plates, bowls, glasses, cutlery, serving utensils, crates, and other reusable food\-service items meet the company's quality, hygiene, and customer standards before dispatch. The role involves inspecting products at every stage of the washing, drying, sorting, packing, and dispatch process to ensure zero\-defect deliveries and maximum customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Quality Inspection**

* Inspect all washed plates, bowls, glasses, cutlery, trays, serving utensils, and containers before packing.
* Ensure items are completely free from:
* Food residue
* Oil and grease
* Water marks
* Stains
* Soap or detergent residue
* Odor
* Dust or contamination
* Reject chipped, cracked, broken, bent, rusted, or damaged items.
* Verify that all items meet company quality standards before approval.

**2\. Dispatch Verification**

* Verify customer\-wise packing quantities before dispatch.
* Ensure correct plate sizes, cutlery types, serving utensils, and accessories are packed according to the dispatch list.
* Cross\-check dispatch against customer orders.
* Prevent shortages, excess quantities, or wrong item dispatches.

**3\. Process Monitoring**

* Monitor washing, rinsing, drying, sorting, and packing activities.
* Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are followed at every stage.
* Conduct random in\-process quality inspections during production.
* Ensure rejected items are not mixed with approved inventory.

**4\. Hygiene \& Food Safety**

* Maintain high hygiene standards in washing, drying, inspection, and packing areas.
* Ensure employees follow personal hygiene requirements, including gloves, uniforms, masks, hairnets, and hand\-washing procedures.
* Verify proper storage of cleaned utensils to prevent contamination.
* Report any hygiene or sanitation violations immediately.

**5\. Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain Daily QC Inspection Reports.
* Record rejection quantities and rejection reasons.
* Prepare Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) reports.
* Maintain customer complaint records.
* Report recurring quality issues to the Operations Manager.

**6\. Continuous Improvement**

* Identify root causes of quality failures.
* Recommend improvements in washing, drying, handling, and packing processes.
* Assist in reducing customer complaints and product rejections.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives and internal audits.

Authority

The QC Executive has the authority to:

* Stop dispatch of non\-conforming materials.
* Reject damaged or improperly cleaned utensils.
* Recommend rewash or rework of rejected items.
* Escalate repeated quality issues to management.
* Request corrective actions from Operations or Washing teams.

Required Skills

* Excellent attention to detail.
* Strong observation and inspection skills.
* Basic knowledge of hygiene, sanitation, and food safety practices.
* Ability to identify quality defects quickly.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced operational environment.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.

Qualifications

* Minimum: 12th Pass.
* Graduate or Diploma in Hospitality, Food Technology, Quality, or Operations is preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in Quality Control, Hospitality, Housekeeping, Laundry, Food Processing, Catering, Warehousing, or Manufacturing.
* Freshers with strong learning ability and discipline may also be considered.

Preferred Qualities

* Responsible and disciplined.
* Honest and dependable.
* Positive attitude.
* High level of integrity.
* Team player.
* Punctual and reliable.
* Ability to maintain consistent quality standards.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* 100% inspection of all dispatch materials.
* Zero dispatch of dirty or damaged items.
* Reduction in customer quality complaints.
* Reduction in rejected or returned materials.
* 100% compliance with SOPs and hygiene standards.
* Dispatch quantity accuracy above 99\.5%.
* Timely reporting of quality issues.
* Reduction in rewash and rework percentage.
* CAPA closure within defined timelines.

Working Conditions

* Work in a plate washing and sanitation facility.
* Standing and walking for extended periods.
* Exposure to wet work areas and cleaning chemicals.
* Rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays, as required.
* Mandatory use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Position Summary**
 We are growing our product team and hiring an APM who owns products end to end, from discovery to launch to adoption. You will define the problem and the experience, write clear user stories, and drive delivery alongside AI Architects and Engineers who own the technical design. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role for someone early in their product career who is deeply AI\-native, fluent in how modern AI products are built, comfortable with data, and hungry to own real outcomes.
   

 You will not just push work through a board. You will own the full software development lifecycle for your area and be accountable for what actually ships and gets adopted. This is a state\-of\-the\-art, AI\-first product role, with modern tooling and real ownership from day one.
   

  

**How our product team works**
 We are building a modern, AI\-native product team, and we want this to be a place where you do the best work of your career so far. A few things you can expect here:
 * Clear communication: We keep our thinking, decisions, and requirements well\-structured and easy to follow across product, engineering, and stakeholders
* Purposeful scope: We align early on a clear MVP and treat new ideas as deliberate next steps, so your work stays focused and actually ships
* Real ownership: You carry initiatives across the full lifecycle and are recognized for the outcomes and adoption they drive
* Building in the open: Prototypes and early check\-ins keep stakeholders close, so feedback shapes the work well before launch
* Close to the customer: Real client conversations and honest data guide what we build
* AI at the core: We build AI\-powered products and we build with AI, from agentic workflows to evaluations, and we keep pace with a fast\-moving field


**What you will do** 
* Own the full product lifecycle for your area: discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and adoption. You will start with our client onboarding and website\-building experience, and grow into our reputation and social products as you ramp
* Speak regularly with our US\-based clients (Voice of Customer): run interviews and conversations, and turn what you hear, alongside usage and adoption data, into product decisions
* Write clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria, and shape and prioritize the backlog
* Own the user experience: UI, data, and front and back\-end interactions
* Lock the MVP and hold scope. Changes after lock become new, prioritized work, not silent scope creep
* Build working prototypes with AI tools, then hand a precise spec to engineering (engineering owns high\-level design and architecture)
* Partner closely with AI and full\-stack engineers, data, and design; keep stakeholders in the loop early and follow up so nothing goes stale
* Keep measurement honest and maintain evaluation sets for AI features
* Own the feedback loop for our internal tools: run a regular pulse with the internal teams who use them and turn what you hear into prioritized product work
* Drive each iteration and the launch, tracking against user needs and adoption
* After launch, monitor success metrics through proper dashboards, and use those results to define future enhancements or revisit the work as needed


**AI knowledge we expect** 
* A strong, practical grasp of how modern AI products work: large language models, prompting and context engineering, retrieval (RAG), knowledge graphs, and agents with tool use
* Evaluations as a first\-class habit: you can design and run evals and benchmarks for AI features, and reason clearly about quality, safety, and hallucination
* AI across your workflow: you use AI for research, prototyping, analysis, and writing, and build working prototypes independently in tools like Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, etc
* Genuine curiosity about a fast\-moving field: you keep pace with new models, tools, and patterns and bring the best of them into how we build


**What we require** 
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Data, or a related field
* 1\-3 years in product, product ownership, business or data analysis, or a closely related role
* Demonstrated understanding of AI/ML products, data, and the full software development lifecycle
* Excellent, fluent communication skills, written and verbal, and comfortable speaking directly with US\-based clients and stakeholders
* Hands\-on with Agile; can run grooming and planning without hand\-holding
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; comfortable with data (spreadsheets and SQL)
* High ownership: able to drive a feature from idea to adoption with minimal supervision


**How We Expect You to Work** 
* You reach for AI naturally to move faster, prototype, and explore ideas
* You take ownership and follow through, closing the loop on what matters
* You are curious and adaptable, and you thrive in a fast\-moving, modern environment
* You make decisions quickly and keep learning as the field evolves


**Desirable** 
* Experience running user or customer interviews
* Awareness of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and scalable\-architecture concepts
* Familiarity with data governance, AI ethics, and regulatory compliance
* Agile or Product Ownership certification (for example, CSPO)
* Experience in healthcare or agency / marketing SaaS


**Position Details** 
* Base Salary: 12 to 15 LPA based on experience and qualifications
* Position Type: Full\-time, Salaried
* Work Locations: This position is fully remote to start, but there is the chance this position will be called back to the office in Bangalore. We will prioritize candidates that are located in Bangalore or willing to relocate there
* Travel: May require occasional local or national travel (less than 5% of the time, if at all)
* Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer (90% at desk, 10% of time walking); Ability to lift up to 30 lbs and use typical office equipment (computers, keyboards, printer, etc.).


**Benefits** 
* Employer\-contributed medical insurance (100% premium covered by the company)
* Provident Fund (PF) contributions as per policy
* Leave policy: 12 Sick/Casual Leaves \+ 18 Annual Leaves \+ 10 Company Holidays
* Remote\-first Company, Flexible Schedules \+ Early Out Fridays!
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP): free mental health support, financial/legal consultations, and more
* Tuition Reimbursement Program (up to ₹1 lakh annually) \+ Executive Mentorship Program
* Leadership Training Program: learn the fundamentals of leading a team (available to all employees)
* Ongoing personalized coaching and career development support
* Casual / Business Casual dress code and a fun work environment (games, coffee, snacks, etc.)
* Core value initiatives: “Pay It Forward,” Project Fantastic (client collaboration), and more!

MyAdvice’s six\-stage Pyramid of Success™ provides a proven step\-by\-step plan for how and when to implement growth\-oriented marketing tactics for greatest impact, including website design and maintenance, local directories, client reviews, social media, search engine optimization (SEO) and paid advertising. Department

The Automobile Trainer is responsible for delivering theoretical and practical training in automobile technology, vehicle maintenance, diagnostics, and repair. The trainer will equip students with industry\-relevant knowledge and hands\-on skills in automotive systems, ensuring they are prepared for employment in the automobile service and manufacturing sectors.

* Deliver classroom lectures and practical training in automobile engineering and vehicle maintenance.

* Transmission and drivetrain systems
* Steering, suspension, and braking systems
* Automotive electrical and electronic systems

* Vehicle diagnostics using OBD scanners and diagnostic equipment
* Preventive maintenance and repair techniques
* Workshop tools, equipment, and safety procedures
* Knowledge of Electric Vehicles (EVs), Hybrid Vehicles, and Automotive Electronics
* Computer literacy and preparation of technical documentation

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong practical demonstration and training abilities
* Classroom and workshop management
* Problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Leadership and mentoring capabilities
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Time management and organizational skills
* Commitment to continuous learning and professional development

* **Freshers** with strong technical knowledge and practical skills may be considered.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Student attendance and participation
* Student practical competency and assessment results
* Timely completion of syllabus and practical modules
* Workshop safety and equipment maintenance
* Student certification and placement outcomes
* Student feedback and satisfaction
* Industry engagement through projects, internships, and workshops
* Compliance with institutional policies and quality standards

Working Conditions

* Classroom and automobile workshop\-based training.
* Regular hands\-on practical sessions using vehicles, engines, and diagnostic equipment.
* May involve online, offline, and hybrid training modes.
* Participation in examinations, industrial visits, workshops, faculty development programs, and institutional events.

Preferred Attributes

* Passion for teaching and mentoring aspiring automobile technicians.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in vehicle maintenance and diagnostics.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and practical manner.
* Awareness of the latest automotive industry trends and technologies.
* Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous professional development.

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers.  Accenture is a trusted, innovative, comprehensive, and experienced partner to leading platform companies. The Trust and Safety offering within Accenture Operations helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses.

* Business Account Onboarding \& Support Manage end\-to\-end onboarding and activation of business and enterprise accounts. * In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines

Experience managing enterprise customer escalations. Knowledge of integration support and onboarding workflows. title: Frontend Developer
description:
**About Ripik.AI**
 Ripik.AI is an Accel\-backed Applied AI company building computer vision and process\-optimisation agents for the world's largest industrial enterprises across steel, cement, aluminium, chemicals, pharma, and power. Our Vision AI platform acts as an automated pair of eyes on the shop floor — monitoring materials, equipment, and processes 24/7 with 95%\+ accuracy, eliminating human error, and delivering measurable gains in throughput, yield, energy efficiency, and safety.
   

  

 We work with marquee customers including Tata Steel, JSW, ArcelorMittal, Vedanta, Godrej \& Boyce, Grasim, Holcim, and Jindal Steel, and are scaling globally across India, the Middle East, Europe, and North America. As we move into our next phase of growth, we are building the operating backbone that will take Ripik from a high\-velocity scale\-up to a category\-defining global industrial AI company.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Frontend Developer at Ripik.AI, you'll build the interfaces that turn real\-time AI into decisions people can act on — dashboards used by plant operators every day, CXO views that shape multi\-million\-dollar decisions, and workflows that make heavy\-industry teams faster and safer.
   

  

 You'll work in React.js and modern frontend tooling, partner with backend engineers, designers, and product to ship features end\-to\-end, and care deeply about the details — performance, accessibility, loading states, empty states, and the feel of every interaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build production frontend features in React.js — from wireframes and design specs to shipped code that runs 24/7 in customer plants.
* Write clean, testable, maintainable code — components that other engineers can read, extend, and trust.
* Partner with backend engineers on REST API contracts — versioning, error handling, loading and empty states, and edge cases.
* Collaborate with designers on interaction, layout, and visual polish — you care about the difference between a shipped product and a designed product.
* Own the details — responsiveness, accessibility, performance, error handling, and the small interactions that make users trust the product.
* Debug production issues on live customer deployments — trace the bug from symptom to root cause, ship the fix, and prevent recurrence.
* Contribute to the design system — reusable components, patterns, and standards that future engineers and products build on.
* Grow with the team — take feedback in code review, learn from senior engineers, and raise your craft steadily over time.


**What You Bring**
* 1–5 years of hands\-on frontend engineering experience.
* Strong React.js — hooks, component design, state management, rendering behaviour.
* Solid JavaScript fundamentals — modern ES6\+, async/await, promises, closures.
* Strong HTML and CSS — semantic markup, flexbox, grid, responsive design, accessibility basics.
* Comfortable working with REST APIs — request/response, error handling, loading and empty states.
* Familiarity with modern frontend tooling — Vite, Webpack, npm/yarn, Git.
* Design sensibility — you notice the difference between good and great UI.
* Ownership mindset — you don't wait for tickets. You see a bug, you fix it. You see a gap, you flag it.


**What You Get**
* Build production interfaces used inside some of India's largest industrial plants — Tata Steel, JSW, Vedanta, and others.
* Direct partnership with senior engineers, designers, and product leaders from IIT Delhi, BITS, Google, IBM, and McKinsey.
* A clear growth path — SDE\-I to SDE\-II to SDE\-III and beyond, with real feedback loops and mentorship.
* World\-class engineering culture — code review, design docs, and clean architecture as defaults.
* A team that cares about craft — animations, empty states, edge cases, and the details that separate good from world\-class.
* A front\-row seat to how a category\-defining industrial AI company is built.


**Nice to Have**
* TypeScript experience — strong types, generics, and comfortable refactoring untyped code into typed.
* State management libraries — Redux, Zustand, React Query, or similar.
* Data visualisation experience — Recharts, D3, Chart.js, or comparable libraries for real\-time dashboards.
* Testing frameworks — Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Design tool fluency — Figma, working closely with designers on specs, prototypes, and design systems.
* Performance optimisation — code\-splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, bundle analysis.
* Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio of frontend projects we can look at.
* Exposure to AI/ML products — building interfaces for chat, agents, data exploration, or real\-time streams.

title: Manager - HR Operations
description:
**Position Title** 




 Manager HR Operations
 



  





**Position Summary:** 




 Manager\- HR Operations oversees end‑to‑end HR processes, ensuring seamless HR service delivery, policy implementation, and compliance. The role manages Performance Management Systems, drives HR budgeting and workforce planning, and provides data‑driven insights through advanced HR analytics to support strategic decision‑making and enhance organizational effectiveness.
 



  





**Job Description:** 




  





**HR Operations Management** 



* Oversee end‑to‑end employee lifecycle processes (onboarding, exits, transfers, letters, HR helpdesk).
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, compliance, and audit requirements across HR Ops functions.
* Lead a team to deliver consistent, high‑quality HR services.
* Establish, monitor, and improve SOPs and service standards.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams (Payroll, Finance, Admin, IT) for seamless employee experience.



  





**Annual Compensation Review Cycle** 



* Lead end‑to‑end Compensation Review Cycle including planning, timelines, calibration management, and system readiness.
* Work closely with C\&B on salary benchmarking, merit and bonus allocations, and internal parity checks.
* Support communication, guidelines, and training for managers during the compensation cycle.
* Ensure data accuracy, approvals, and governance through all stages



  





**HR Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Develop and maintain HR dashboards, MIS, and analytical reports for leadership.
* Drive data accuracy, standardization, and governance across all HR systems.
* Provide insights on workforce trends (attrition, hiring, productivity, talent movement, headcount).
* Partner with HRBPs and COEs to translate data into actionable recommendations.



**Budgeting, Headcount \& MPC Management** 



* Lead annual HR budgeting cycles in partnership with Finance and business leaders.
* Manage and track manpower costs (MPC) including forecasting, variance analysis, and monthly reconciliations.
* Monitor approved vs. actual headcount, open positions, and cost implications.
* Drive adherence to headcount governance, approvals, and controls.



**HR Automation \& Process Improvement** 



* Identify automation opportunities across HR processes to improve efficiency and user experience.
* Partner with IT and system vendors to implement HR tech enhancements (HRIS, workflows, dashboards).
* Drive digitization initiatives and streamline manual processes through technology solutions.
* Ensure system stability, data integrity, and continuous improvements.



  





**Qualifications:** 




 Any Graduate (Preferably B.Com) with PG in Human Resources.
 



  





**Work Experience:** 




 The ideal candidate is a seasoned HR professional with 8–10 years of hands‑on experience in managing comprehensive HR Operations, including employee lifecycle management, compliance, and policy implementation. They should possess strong expertise in Performance Management Systems (PMS), Annual Compensation Review (ACR), and HR MIS reporting, with proven ability in HR budgeting, workforce planning, and data‑driven analytics. The candidate must bring a track record of process excellence, stakeholder management, and driving operational efficiency within a dynamic HR environment. Experience in Pharm industry will be preferred.
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies:** 



* HR Operations Management
* Performance Management Systems (PMS)
* ACR Management
* HR Budgeting \& Workforce Planning
* HR MIS \& Analytics
* HRIS Tools
* Compliance \& Audit
* Advance Excel

**Talent, Engagement, and Culture** 



* Identify and develop leadership talent for pipeline and succession planning, including building leadership pipelines for delivery heads

* Drive engagement initiatives tailored to distributed Operations teams
* Partner with all HR functions, including Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, Compensation, Benefits, and HR Operations, to deliver quality service

* Bring global best practices into local execution

title: Talent Coordinator
description:
Scopely is looking for a
 **Talent Coordinator** 
 to join our Talent Acquisition team operating on a hybrid schedule from our Bangalore hub! This hybrid role involves working from the office 3–5 days per week.
   

  

 At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day \- whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
   

  

 We make sure our teams have everything they need to create amazing games. The People team manages everything from benefits \& employee engagement to professional development opportunities and more!
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Talent Coordinator, you’re not just managing logistics, you’re orchestrating a candidate experience that reflects who we are and what we value. You are the engine behind our recruiting process that empowers interviewers to show up prepared, talent partners to focus on strategy, and candidates to bring their best selves. You thrive at getting things done in a fast\-moving and ever\-evolving environment and you're not afraid to take smart risks to make things better.
   

  

* Coordinate and arrange all candidate interviews, including booking travel accommodations for non\-local candidates
* Manage candidates in Greenhouse (applicant tracking system)
* Champion an exceptional candidate experience from start to finish
* Coordinate complex interview schedules across global time zones with multiple participants
* Collaborate with Talent Partners (recruiters) to ensure a great candidate experience and facilitate processes such as interviews, offers, and background checks
* Work with People Operations, People Business Partners, and People Experience teams on efforts to optimize processes, workflow, and reporting
* Assist the Talent Acquisition team in tracking metrics, candidate surveys and reporting
* Contribute to the evolution of our recruitment processes by working closely with the team


**What We’re Looking For**
* High\-volume recruitment coordination experience
* Self\-directed, detail\-oriented, problem solver with a burning desire to contribute
* Ability to develop strong trusting relationships in a demanding and high\-performing work environment
* Strong collaboration, written and verbal communication skills
* Gmail, Google Calendar and Google docs proficiency
* Experience working with an Applicant Tracking system or CRM
* Strong English language skills are required for this role as we have a highly diverse and global business


**About Scopely**
 Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all\-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live\-operates one of the most diversified and award\-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
   

  

 Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world\-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet\-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the \#1 mobile games company in the U.S. and \#2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
   

  

 Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.
   

  

 Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.
   

  

 Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.
   

  

 Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.
   

  

 Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

title: People Support Services Partner
description:
Location: Noida, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Primary Purpose Of Role**
 The People Services Partner role is aligned to the Thales HR organization and will provide HR services to various regions. The role will provide first level support to employees, HR, managers and vendors with Human Resources needs, including but not limited to company policy, procedures, learning, HR systems, employee onboarding etc. ensuring all SLA’s are met.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities**
**Case Management:**
* Respond to a wide variety of employee queries.
* Thoroughly document inquiries via the case management tool to ensure required information is recorded accurately in accordance with policies and practices.
* Track and follow up on employee\-related matters.
* Ensure SLA’s are followed and met.


**Onboarding:**
* Complete and track new hire activities from offer letter creation through the end of their onboarding.
* Initiate any business\-specific tasks required during the onboarding process.
* Coordinate immigration and relocation processes and interact with immigration consultants and vendors to establish correct documentation, procedures, and requirements for external hires.
* Communicate with the new hire regarding next steps, outstanding actions, and any questions they may have.
* Support the Talent Acquisition Team with any requisition corrections or troubleshoot any difficulties.
* Track and monitor probation completion.


**HRIS:**
* Ensure integrity and quality of data in the HRIS databases as well as in the Case Management System.
* Support HRIS data records and workflow pertaining to employees and ensure entries are timely, accurate and consistent in relation to employee data.
* Support generation of standard HRIS reports as requested.
* Participate with testing in instances for new HRIS rollouts.


**Employee Data Management:**
* Ensure integrity and quality of data in the HRIS databases as well as in the Case Management System.
* Support HRIS data records and workflow pertaining to employees and ensure entries are timely, accurate and consistent in relation to cost center transfers, collective agreements, etc.
* Review employee transactions and generate appropriate documents and letters as needed.
* Escalate any Tier 2 HRIS issues to the relevant team.


**Training:**
* Update available courses and training records in the Learning Management System (LMS).
* Assist employees and managers in the use of the LMS.
* Schedule requested trainings.
* Assist in preparing training materials as needed for internally hosted events.
* Manage procurement requisitions and invoicing related to courses and training materials.


**Talent and Performance**
* Generate reports as required
* Support transactions in Workday to support processes
* Support manager and employees on process queries


**Offboarding**
* Coordinate and trigger voluntary post\-termination activities such as post\-termination letters and departure checklists
* Complete all post termination actions e.g enrolling in alumni networks, removal from any assigned future events
* Consolidate exit insights results


**Other:**
* Initiate employee notifications as required.
* Prepare various employee letters in a timely manner outside of the HRIS workflow (letter of employment/employment verification, invitation letters, salary and merit letters etc.).
* Participate in audits as needed (probation, data checks).
* Contribute to the development of HR process documents and employee reference materials.
* Maintain knowledge of company and departmental policies and procedures.
* Support Thales’ HR department with special projects, mass communications, and other duties as needed and assigned.


**Experience and Skills:**
* Either 2\-years of experience in of experience working in HR or an administrative support role or a University Degree or Diploma in Human Resources or a related field
* Proficient in English (both written and oral).
* Ability to work well and collaborate in a team environment.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Ability to handle situations tactfully when dealing with customers.
* Ability to prioritize duties during periods of high volume and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong time management skills (meeting SLAs).
* Discretion to deal with personal and confidential information with sensitivity and tact.
* Adaptable to changing business practices.
* Proficient with Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Solid critical thinking skills.


**Highly Desirable:**
* Prior experience with ServiceNow or another HR case management tool.
* Prior experience with Workday or similar HRIS systems.
* Knowledge of HR practices either through post\-secondary education, an HR professional designation, and/or work experience in HR.
* Experience in a customer service or shared services environment.


 Education and Qualifications:
   

  

* A Graduate Degree.


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Operational Specialist
description:
**WANTED! The World's Most Driven Remote Operations Specialist** 




  





**🌎 About Chore** 




 Chore exists to kill admin so founders can "Chore No More" and build their dreams. We are the end of admin. We are the future. We are the better world for everyone.
 



  
 



 We exist to make every startup in the world successful. The more startups that exist, survive and thrive, the better the world we all get to live in. We work behind the scenes to help our clients win.
 



  
 



 We like efficiency. We geek out on checklists. We're transparent with each other and with our clients. We're professional, inclusive and autonomous, and we're building a culture that's trust\-based, genuinely fun, and pushes each of us to keep learning.
 



  
 



 Check out more of what we do here: www.hirechore.com
 



  





**🚀 The Role** 




 We're looking for a driven person to join our team of Operations Specialists \-
 **the main conduit through which all of our clients' back\-office operations run** 
 , including Human Resources, Finance, Payroll and Compliance.
 



  
 



 As an Operations Specialist, you work directly with US startup founders to project manage their most critical operational matters. You work alongside a Chief Chore Officer, who owns the relationship \-
 **you own the operations.** 
 In short: you're the point person who keeps the lights on.
 



  
 



 These responsibilities are often tactical. But tactical doesn't mean thoughtless \- and as you build trusted relationships with the founders you support, the work becomes strategic too. Our best Operations Specialists end up being the person a founder calls first.
 



  





**🎯 Some Examples Of The Work We Do** 



* **Tactical responsibilities still require judgment and thoughtfulness** 
 \- “can you work with our accountant to get taxes filed?” or “can you get this NDA out to a customer and coordinate if there are any issues?”
* **Work that gets genuinely strategic** 
 \- e.g., “how should I think about compensation and benchmarks for my company?” We’ve seen this organically happen at times, when OPs have built a trusted relationship with clients.
* **Research and problem\-solving for back\-office edge cases.** 
 An unusual filing. A regulator with an unhelpful website. A vendor who's gone quiet. Something that has genuinely never come up before. You go and find the answer
* **Choosing tools and vendors, with the cost in mind.** 
 Our clients are early\-stage and often bootstrapped. You research the options, compare them properly, and recommend what actually fits their budget \- not the biggest name in the market. We expect you to know what things cost and to raise it before anyone asks you to.
* **Contributing to our knowledge base.** 
 Internal, client\-facing, and public\-facing. Every startup on earth reinvents the wheel on HR, Finance and Legal Ops, and it drives us crazy. We're building a reusable source of wisdom and best practice \- and what you learn goes into it, so nobody has to solve the same problem twice.
* **Internal projects that make Chore stronger.** 
 SOPs, systems, dashboards, operational improvements \- scoped, executed and delivered by you.



  





***One note on scope:***
*unlike an internal Chief of Staff, this role doesn't extend into bespoke areas like go\-to\-market, analytics or partnerships.* 




  





**🧠 What We're Looking For** 




  





**Required** 



* **3\+ years of work experience that includes interfacing with clients or external parties.** 
 This is required, not preferred. What matters most is that you were the person responsible for outcomes, not a contributor to someone else's.



  





**Strongly preferred** 



* **HR, Payroll, Finance or Compliance operations experience** 
*(We're not looking for a recruitment or sales background)*



  





**And you're probably a fit if…** 



* **You're a total geek for better processes** 
 \- more standardisation, and reinventing things just enough to make them more efficient.
* **Ticking items off your list while thinking
 *"how could I do this more efficiently?"* 
 brings a smile to your face.** 
 There's always more to do for clients, and you thrive on getting things done
* **You're obsessed with using AI and technology to work smarter** 
 \- you don't wait to be told about a new tool, you've usually already tested it
* **You love building deep, trusting relationships** 
 with dynamic founders across many industries
* **You're smart, detail\-oriented, a natural context\-switcher, with GREAT communication skills**
* **You have a deep dedication to client service** 
 and doing right by people \- going above and beyond to make sure our clients love us
* **You can focus in stressful situations and prioritise almost automatically**
* **You're open to giving and receiving feedback** 
 , up, down and sideways, using the Radical Candor method
* **You start solving before you start asking.** 
 When something breaks and there's nobody available, you get going. You escalate with a recommendation, not a question
* **You don't mind the unsexy part of running a startup** 
 \- dealing with regulators (including waiting on hold forever for them to pick up), managing employee offboardings, and basically doing the "startup plumber" work. It might smell, but a strong back office is foundational to success
* **You want to join a passionate, fun and kind team for the long term (2\+ years).** 
 This role might be a stepping stone, and we celebrate our team members' growth \- but if you apply, our assumption is that you'd prefer a job you can see yourself in for several years over one you expect to leave within twelve months



  
 



**Nice to have, not required** 



* An understanding of bookkeeping, accounting, or early\-stage startup finance
* Comfort with ClickUp, Slack, Notion, and Google Suite



  





**🎁 Why This Role Is Special** 



* **You will run real companies behind the scenes.** 
 Very few roles give you this much impact this early
* **You get ownership from day one.** 
 From the moment you start, you are running real systems for real companies \- not shadowing or waiting to be handed responsibility
* **You get rare visibility.** 
 You'll see how multiple US startups actually operate behind the scenes. Operators almost never get this
* **You work with sharp, ambitious teammates** 
 who care deeply about doing things well
* **You will grow faster than you imagined \-** 
 start by partnering with experienced Chief of Staffs



  





**💵 Compensation \& Logistics** 



* **Compensation.** 
 We believe in full transparency. Below is what we pay by market, with quarterly bonuses
 **of up to 30% based on performance.**
* **India** 
 \- $12K USD/year
* **Nigeria / Africa** 
 \- $10\.4K USD/year
* **LATAM** 
 \- $13K USD/year



***Note***
*: we do not negotiate as we believe it is biased against various groups and creates poor dynamics. Instead, we pay and promote based on performance and meeting clearly defined metrics.* 



* **Equity.** 
 All team members receive equity. Further grants are awarded based on performance and tenure.
* **Benefits** 
*(all eligible after you complete the 60\-day probation period)*
* Up to $250/month WFH stipend
* Up to $50/month wellness stipend
* **Location.** 
 We're remote\-first and proud of it. If you're good with our compensation and US working hours, the world is yours.
* **Schedule.** 
 US business hours, Eastern or Pacific Time. This is mandatory and it can be challenging. If you can't consistently work EST or PST hours, this role won't be a good fit.



  





**🦨 Read Before Applying** 




 We believe in being upfront about the hard parts.
 


* **US hours are required and can be demanding.** 
 This may not be suitable for everyone
* **Remote work has real challenges.** 
 You need reliable WiFi, power backup, and a quiet workspace
* **High ambiguity.** 
 You must create structure, not wait for it
* **Extreme context\-switching.** 
 You'll juggle multiple clients, internal stakeholders and projects at the same time
* **Feedback fluency.** 
 You must be comfortable giving and receiving feedback up, down and sideways
* **High ownership.** 
 Minimal hand\-holding. You are expected to self\-manage
* **Client\-facing pressure.** 
 Founders move fast and expect clarity
* **60\-day fully paid probation period.** 
 We want everyone to feel set up for success from day one. In your first 60 days, success looks like confidently owning and running core client workflows with minimal oversight and communicating proactively with clients and teammates.



  





 If this energizes you rather than intimidates you, you're probably a great fit.
 



  





**❤️ Our Values** 



* **Delight All Stakeholders.** 
 Make work feel easier, clearer and more thoughtful for clients, teammates and yourself
* **Meritocracy.** 
 We reward value created \- not longevity
* **Experiment \& Adapt.** 
 Try things, learn fast, improve continuously
* **Assume Good Intentions.** 
 Take feedback well. Fix things proactively. Be a force multiplier



  





**📝 How to Apply \[READ CAREFULLY]** 




  





 Please read this section carefully \- following the instructions is part of how we assess applications.
 



 Your application has two parts.
 **Both are required.** 




  





**Step 1 \- Record a short video** 




 Record
 **one video, no longer than 3 minutes** 
 , answering these two questions:
 



**1\. Why is this role not a good fit for most people, and why is it for you?** 




**2\. Pick something from the last three years that was yours to lead on your own \- not something you supported someone else on. Tell us what you decided, who else was involved and what they did, and what it cost or saved.** 




  
 



**A few notes:** 



* Answer both questions in a single video (loom preferred)
* We're not judging production quality \- we want to hear how you think
* *We appreciate the use of AI. We don't want AI\-generated answers (trust us, we can tell). Tell us your story, in your own words, please.*



  





**Step 2 \- Submit the application form** 




*(Only once your video is recorded)* 




  





**Form:** 
 https://levy.clickup.com/forms/42034173/f/182rzx\-2152553/X00JSW8E6JY71N2O87
 



**When sharing your resume, please name as follows:** 
 Firstname.Lastname.OS \- Resume \- for example, Jane.Doe.OS \- Resume. PDF preferred.
 



  





**What Happens Next** 




 We move quickly, and we'd rather you know exactly what's coming:
 


* **We review your application and video** 
 \- usually within a week
* **A 20\-minute screening call** 
 , so we can get to know you
* **A paid case study** 
 \- 1 to 2 hours of work, with 72 hours to complete it. You'll receive a payment for your time
* **Four interviews** 
 , to meet different team members including a Chief Chore Officer (30 mins), a current Operations Specialist (30 mins), our head of Client Operations (30 mins) and finally our CEO (15 mins)
* **Offer rollout**



  





 We aim to go from application to decision in around three weeks.
