title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the role**
 To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department's future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L \- Listen and be authentic, E \- Energise and inspire, A \- Align across the enterprise, D \- Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship \- our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset \- to Empower, Challenge and Drive \- the operating manual for how we behave.
   

  

 At Barclays, we don't just adapt to the future \- we create it. Embark on a transformative journey as part of the Business Analyst \- Finance Data Transformation, where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring the resilience, scalability, and reliability of critical payment systems within the Merchant Services domain. You will be a key contributor championing quality and performance for systems that power merchant transactions, focusing on driving improvements in system stability, throughput, efficiency, and control.
   

  

 Working closely with Engineering teams and stakeholders across Finance Data Transformation team, you will help Engineering team deliver high\-performing solutions through agile delivery models.
   

  

 Leading the ongoing drive to enhance platform performance and reliability, you will champion a data\-driven and collaborative approach, ensuring that performance considerations are embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. Additionally, ensuring compliance with performance standards, risk controls, and service\-level expectations will be a key responsibility.
   

  

**To be successful as a Business Analyst, you should have experience with:**
* Experience in translating business and operational needs into succinct requirements, and associated analysis and design articulation methods.
* Experience across the full project lifecycle (from inception to closure) with strong knowledge of Agile methodologies.
* Understanding of the Finance or Risk data.
* Ability to use effective questioning techniques to identify, analyse and address underlying business needs.
* Strong understanding of risk management, control environments, and policy frameworks.
* Good understanding of Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban.
* Experience with delivery workflow and articulation tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Strong MS Office skills, including advanced Excel (formulas, VLOOKUPs, macros), Word and PowerPoint.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**
* Formal training in business analysis and change management.
* Understanding of data integration concepts, including APIs and data transfer mechanisms.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based applications and platforms.
* Experience within the financial services industry.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The location of the role is Chennai, IN

title: MTS- II ( Frontend )
description:
Adobe takes pride in crafting a work environment where innovation meets collaboration. As a Member of Technical Staff 2, you will work alongside a world\-class team of engineers to develop solutions that have a global impact. You'll have the opportunity to sharpen your skills, contribute to meaningful projects, and help build products that millions of people use every day.
   

  

 The Engineer will be part of the Commerce Experiences team, responsible for delivering commerce experiences across Adobe products. We run experiments and optimize user journeys to drive Acquisition and Retention workflows. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on problem solver who writes clean, well\-tested frontend code and thrives in a collaborative, feedback\-rich environment.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Implement frontend components and features within established design and engineering parameters, contributing to user experience improvements across Adobe's commerce surfaces.
* Work with senior engineers, architects, and product managers to understand requirements and translate them into well\-structured, testable UI code.
* Contribute to UI rendering and experience delivery workflows, with growing ownership as you build familiarity with the codebase.
* Write unit and component\-level tests; participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality.
* Debug and resolve issues within your own code and immediate component integrations.
* Communicate progress clearly within your team, ask good questions, and demonstrate a bias toward continued learning.


**What You'll Need To Succeed**
* 2–4 years of experience building frontend web applications with responsive design and modular, maintainable code.
* Proficiency in modern JavaScript and at least one major framework — React preferred; familiarity with TypeScript or ES6\+ is a plus.
* Working knowledge of web standards and browser fundamentals — DOM, CSS (including SCSS), and debugging in modern browsers.
* Experience creating unit and component\-focused tests; exposure to integration or E2E testing is a bonus.
* Familiarity with Git and basic CI/CD workflows.
* Awareness of secure coding practices and frontend performance considerations.
* Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to write, test, and iterate on code within established standards.
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and a collaborative, team\-first attitude.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.


**Nice to have**
* Exposure to state management patterns (Redux, MobX, or similar).
* Basic familiarity with CDNs, Service Workers, or progressive rendering concepts.

 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
   

  

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call \+1 408\-536\-3015\.

title: Software Dev Engineer II
description:
As an SDE II at Swiggy, you will design, build, and own large\-scale, high\-concurrency backend
   

  

 systems that power products used by millions of customers every day. You will take services
   

  

 from a blank page to production \- defining the architecture, making the technology choices, and
   

  

 owning reliability, performance, and scale end to end. You will co\-drive your team's technical
   

  

 vision, raise the bar on engineering quality, and mentor other developers as they grow. Equally
   

  

 important, our platforms are increasingly intelligent: you will build and integrate LLM\-driven and
   

  

 agentic AI workflows into these systems, collaborating with product and business teams to
   

  

 translate product features into agent\-driven, production\-grade designs. We are looking for a
   

  

 strong systems engineer with solid AI experience \- someone who thinks deeply about data
   

  

 modeling, distributed systems, and what it takes to keep services fast and dependable under
   

  

 real\-world load, and who knows how to bring LLM\-powered capabilities into that world reliably.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What qualities are we looking for?**
* B Tech/M Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college with a minimum of 3\-5 years of experience in a product development company.
* Proven experience designing and building distributed, high\-concurrency, low\-latency


 backend systems at scale.
   

  

* Has built multiple services from scratch and owned them end to end \- architecture,


 development, deployment, monitoring, and on\-call operations.
   

  

* Strong grasp of scalability fundamentals: caching, queuing/async processing, sharding and


 partitioning, replication, load balancing, rate limiting, and fault tolerance.
   

  

* Strong design skills involving data modeling, low\-level class design, API design, and


 system design.
   

  

* Good knowledge of object\-oriented programming, concurrency primitives, and design


 patterns.
   

  

* Proficiency in at least one programming language \- Python, Java, Golang.
* Hands\-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases, messaging systems (e.g.,


 Kafka, SQS), and Linux/Unix platforms.
   

  

* Follows industry coding standards and is responsible for writing maintainable, scalable,


 and efficient code to solve business problems.
   

  

* A strong team player who has mentored junior developers and helped raise the technical


 bar of the team.
   

  

* Hands\-on experience integrating LLMs from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic


 (Claude), Bedrock, and Azure OpenAI into production systems.
   

  

* Practical experience with LangChain or LangGraph for building AI\-driven workflows and


 orchestration; exposure to agentic/multi\-agent architectures preferred.
   

  

* Strong technical aptitude and good knowledge of CS fundamentals.


**What will you get to do here?**
* Architect and build new backend services from the ground up, and evolve existing systems for higher scale, concurrency, and reliability.
* Own end\-to\-end architecture for your team's systems and implement the long\-term


 technology vision for your team.
   

  

* Come up with best practices to help the team achieve their technical tasks and continually


 improve the technology of the product/team.
   

  

* Drive the adoption of best practices through regular participation in code reviews, design


 reviews, and architecture discussions.
   

  

* Mentor and guide developers on the team through design feedback, pairing, and code


 reviews.
   

  

* Design and ship AI\-driven and agentic workflows within your services, and experiment with


 new and relevant technologies and tools, driving adoption while measuring yourself on the
   

  

 impact you create.
   

  

* Decide technology and tool choices for your team and be responsible for them.

 B Tech/M Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college with minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in product development company.

title: Software Engineer, Frontend/Fullstack
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
 WisdomAI builds AI\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
   

  

 We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**This role**
 Backed by Wisdom's adaptive context layer, at the core is generative UI: the charts, dashboards, and insights are generated, not built screen by screen. And it runs wherever people already are: web, mobile, Slack or embedded within their web app. The problems are hard, the UX has no playbook!
   

  

 You own a user\-facing surface end to end and sweat how it feels. We're hiring at the mid to senior level, with room for staff engineers who still love to build.
   

  

 How we work
   

  

**Builders:** 
 You're a frontend engineer at heart. Some of us run 50/50 frontend and backend. Some stay frontend\-heavy on the hard UI and visualization work. We build the role around you.
   

  

**Ownership** 
 :Engineers own projects here, from requirements to ship. PMs and designers are partners and input, not a queue you wait behind. Wherever the work starts, we build it – together.
   

  

**Proximity:** 
 You'll work closely with customers, through sales and support and as directly as you want. Staying close is how any of us build something people love to use.
   

  

**Judgement:** 
 We all work across the stack with AI doing a lot of the typing. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, pick your flavor, most of us use all three. So the job isn't typing anymore. It's taste and judgment about what's worth building and whether it's any good.
   

  

**Fluidity:** 
 The work spans three teams: Dashboard \& Visualization, Chat \& Context, and Agents \& Integrations. You'll land where you fit and where the work is, and move between them as the product grows.
   

  

 What you'd work on
   

  

 A few of the problems open right now:
   

  

* Generating code that produces visualizations good enough to ship: charts, and dense P\&L tables where every number and pixel has to land. Two hard parts. The data transforms that turn raw rows into a real financial statement, and chart specs that come out looking like a pro built them, without latency growing as the visual gets more complex.
* Designing the edit experience for AI\-generated visuals, where typing a follow\-up and reaching for a knob should feel like the same product. Live\-preview controls only work if the visual comes out parameterized in the first place, with the knobs UI built from those parameters.
* Streaming a chat agent's thinking as a trace you can click into, so a business user can watch what it did and open any step while it's still running. The trick is turning a messy pile of tool calls into something that reads like a sentence. It should earn trust in the answer and still get out of the way of the result.
* Building the React SDK other data teams build on, to drop in dashboards and chat or assemble something of their own with WisdomAI underneath. It lives or dies on the abstraction: the APIs, the docs, the examples that make building on us feel easy instead of like a fight.


 You may be a good fit if you
   

  

* Ship with React, TypeScript, and Node, and obsess over the polish and the details
* Have product instinct: you can take a fuzzy customer pain and decide what's worth building
* Run on high agency, you find the work and drive it instead of waiting for a ticket
* Want customers close enough that they shape what you build
* Have a Bachelor's in Computer Science or equivalent


 Strong candidates may also have
   

  

* Data viz, BI, GenUI or dashboarding experience
* A real eye for design and polish
* Time at an early\-stage or founding team


 Not sure this is the right fit?
   

  

* Backend engineer at heart who'll happily dip into UI when needed? Check out Software Engineer, Backend @ WisdomAI
* Design engineer who wants to live in design systems, Figma, and interaction craft? Check out Design Engineer @ WisdomAI


**Our CRAFT**
 CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
   

  

**C — Customer trust.** 
 Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
   

  

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** 
 We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
   

  

**A — Authenticity.** 
 We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
   

  

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** 
 We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real\-world results decide.
   

  

**T — Transparency.** 
 We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
   

  

**Equal opportunity employer**
 WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

 **Frontend Engineer** 
 to help build next\-generation platforms that power agentic AI models for the legal industry. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI, scalable infrastructure, and legal innovation, building intelligent systems that streamline workflows, enhance legal research, and automate complex decision\-making. It's a great opportunity to build enterprise\-grade resilient platforms and services that are backed by cutting edge generative ai based solutions for some of the big Fortune 500 companies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* System Ownership: Taking full ownership of significant frontend modules, design systems, and UI platforms ensuring pixel\-perfect implementation and non\-functional excellence. Design and deliver resilient and extensible user interfaces.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Working closely with other engineering teams, including product managers, designers, and backend engineers to align on technical roadmaps and deliver impactful user experiences.
* Performance Optimization: Identifying and resolving rendering bottlenecks, optimizing bundle sizes, reducing load times, and ensuring smooth 60fps interactions across the application.
* Innovation and Development: Contributing to the evolution of the frontend stack and component library by implementing modern frameworks, design patterns, and emerging web platform capabilities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's in Computer Science, Design Engineering, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field (Masters preferred).

* Communication and Collaboration: Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, effectively collaborating with cross\-functional teams including designers and product stakeholders.


**Why You'll Love Working Here**
* Impactful Work: Be part of a team that's at the forefront of AI innovation.

Aditya Birla Finance Limited ("ABFL") is a lending subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited. ABFL is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABFL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Dec’20, ABFL has a pan\-India presence with 91 branches and a lending book of Rs. 45,560 Crores.  

ABFL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. Collections function carries out monitoring of client wise exposure and portfolio exposure to identify ‘early warning signals’ of stress and to minimize NPAs. This monitoring is done by dedicated teams who specialize in managing delinquent customers who have come under financial stress due to unfavourable market events / changes in business patterns and as well as from those customers who have intentionally stopped payment of dues with mala\-fide intentions. It also carries out overdue loan recovery from defaulting clients.  

The Small ticket segment comprises primarily Digitally sourced accounts with ticket sizes ranging 10k – 5 lacs. This role is responsible for enhancing business profitability through effective management of the delinquent portfolio in the respective zone.

**Talent Sourcing Specialist (Apprentice)**

**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


We are currently seeking fresh Graduates to join the Talent Acquisition team as Apprentice for duration of 12 months.


This role forms part of the Talent Acquisition team and will have responsibility for driving excellence in the Sourcing function. The role will work closely with the HR and business leaders across the organisation and be an advocate/champion for TA.

**PRIMARY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Delivery of Sourcing ‘assignments’ which could include supporting Executive Search, talent mapping/pooling, succession planning or open roles
* Proactively sourcing, screening and talent pooling for candidates through various channels including internal databases, LinkedIn and other external job boards and open web searching
* Develop and execute against Sourcing plans for specific assignments
* Contribute to the ongoing evolvement of HSBC’s proactive Sourcing capability and effectiveness
* Staying connected with and tracking market trends, competitor analysis and regional changes that are relevant to our business stakeholders
* Designing and implementing bespoke recruitment campaigns for key recruitment drives
* Working in partnership with Resourcing Specialists and working closely with hiring managers from the outset – from market research, job briefs through to interviews and offer management
* Ensure that the EVP for your assignments is defined and will have impact
* Ensure that the EVP for your assignments is defined and will have impact
* Ensure the metrics set against deliverables is met
* Provide input to the TA Leadership Team on key components of the function
* Ensure HSBC fully leverages its CRM tools, resources and tactics to engage talent

**Qualifications \- External**

* Graduation / Post\-Graduation (Bachelor’s degree holder of an UGC recognised University and must possess mark sheets and provisional / Degree certificate of passing)
* Only Fresh Graduates within 0\-5 years of completing their Bachelor’s degree can apply
* Candidate should not have done any Govt. regulated Apprenticeship in past
* Basic knowledge of full cycle recruiting and Sourcing
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and facilitation skills
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and critical thinking
* Professional and strong presentation skills to senior level stakeholders
* Culturally diverse and aware and able to work with people of different backgrounds and languages

**Additional Information**

* The tenure of the Apprentice will be 1 (one) year as defined under Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992 amended from time to time.
* All Apprentices engaged by the Bank will also be featured in NATS portal as an ‘Apprentice’. By virtue of them being covered under the provisions of the Act, a candidate profile will be created for each apprentice in the NATS portal, which will be available to them for viewing.
* On completion of the one\-year Apprenticeship tenure, a Certificate of Proficiency will be issued to the apprentice by the Govt. of India, as applicable under the Act and the enrollment under the Apprenticeship Act will cease.
* All other clauses regarding the tenure of engagement as an Apprentice with HSBC will stand as mentioned in the offer letter issued by the Bank at the time of joining.


Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.


You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:

For more information, please visit:* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud*

  

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than **5,500\+ employees** and **\~30,000 customers** worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.


Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.


Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

*Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection.*

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**


Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.


Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

**About this role:**


This is predominantly a leadership role within the Learning \& Organizational Development (L\&OD) function. We are looking for a seasoned professional who combines sharp strategic thinking with strong execution capability — someone who can design, drive, and scale impactful learning and organizational development initiatives while also partnering closely with business leaders to build capability and culture.

  


In This Role, You Will::
### **1\. Strategic Learning Delivery \& Business Impact**

* Lead the design and execution of the Open Enrollment Learning Calendar, Management Development programs, and enterprise L\&OD initiatives aligned to business strategy.
* Partner with business leaders to identify capability gaps and build targeted learning journeys for emerging and senior leaders.
* Deliver high\-impact facilitation sessions (20–30 hours/month) across virtual, in\-person, and hybrid formats.
* Apply measurement frameworks such as Kirkpatrick (Levels 1–4\) to evaluate effectiveness, impact, and ROI of learning programs.

### **2\. Instruction Design \& AI\-Enabled Learning**

* Design learner\-centric solutions using ADDIE, Bloom’s Taxonomy, and adult learning principles.
* Build structured learning journeys, microlearning, and blended programs incorporating experiential methodologies (case studies, simulations, real\-world problem solving).
* **Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Azure AI, Synthesia, Glean, etc.) to design, personalize, and scale learning experiences — AI fluency is a critical requirement for this role.**
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled learning solutions to enhance efficiency, learner engagement, and content effectiveness.
* Ensure seamless integration of content within LMS platforms.

### **3\. Talent Development \& Succession Enablement**

* Partner in talent review cycles to identify high\-potential talent and critical skill gaps.
* Design and implement individualized and cohort\-based development plans aligned with succession pipelines and leadership capability building.
* Aligning learning strategies with career frameworks and long\-term organizational capability needs.

### **4\. Strategic Learning Projects**

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of large\-scale training and capability\-building initiatives (leadership development, functional academies, enterprise interventions).
* Define project scope, timelines, success metrics, and governance.
* Manage cross\-functional stakeholders and external vendors to ensure high\-quality delivery within timelines and budgets.
* Track risks, monitor outcomes, and present insights to senior leadership.

### **5\. Organizational Development \& Business Partnership**

* Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on organization effectiveness, capability building, and culture transformation.
* Diagnose organizational needs and recommend targeted OD interventions including team effectiveness, leadership alignment, and change initiatives.

### **6\. Leadership \& Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of L\&OD professionals, building strong capability in facilitation, instructional design, and consulting skills.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Enable team members to effectively leverage digital and AI tools in learning design and delivery.

### **7\. Learning Analytics \& Insights**

* Track, analyze, and interpret learning data (participation, engagement, effectiveness, business impact).
* Build dashboards and executive reports on talent readiness and capability outcomes.
* Use data\-driven insights to continuously refine learning strategies and interventions.


Here's What You Need::
* **Education**:
* + MBA in HR / Master’s in Organizational Psychology or related field (preferred)
* **Experience**:
* + 15\+ years of experience in Learning \& Development, Talent Development, or Organizational Development
	+ Proven experience leading large\-scale, cross\-functional L\&OD initiatives
* **Core Expertise**:
* + Strong instructional design expertise (ADDIE, Bloom’s Taxonomy, adult learning principles)
	+ Deep experience in leadership development and capability building
	+ Strong facilitation and executive presence
* **AI \& Digital Capability (Critical Requirement)**:
* + **Hands\-on experience with AI\-powered tools (e.g., Copilot, Azure AI, Glean, Synthesia, etc.) in learning design, content creation, and personalization**
	+ **Ability to integrate AI into learning strategy, delivery, and analytics**
	+ Strong digital fluency with LMS platforms and learning technologies
* **Technical \& Analytical Skills**:
* + Expertise in LMS platforms (Docebo or similar)
	+ Advanced MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and data visualization tools
	+ Knowledge of Kirkpatrick Model and learning ROI measurement
	+ Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capability
* **Leadership \& Consulting Skills**:
* + Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills with senior leadership
	+ Ability to operate as both strategic advisor and execution leader
	+ Experience managing and developing high\-performing teams
* **Certifications (Preferred)**:
* + Instructional Design, Facilitation certifications
	+ Assessments/tools such as MBTI, Harrison, Situational Leadership II
* **Other Requirements**:
* + Comfortable working in global environments (including periodic East Coast shift alignment)

DESCRIPTION:  

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, manage a field service team to deliver excellent technical support while growing service business. You'll manage a team of Field Service Engineers (FSEs) providing installation, maintenance, repairs, and customer support for sophisticated analytical and scientific instruments. This role combines technical leadership, people management, and strategic business development to ensure excellent customer experiences and meet organizational goals.  

  

Help advance scientific service delivery by implementing effective solutions, optimizing team performance, and building strong customer relationships. Support continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety. Collaborate with sales, technical support, and other stakeholders to develop and execute service strategies that grow revenue and enhance customer satisfaction.

* **Operational Excellence:** Monitor team KPIs, ensuring adherence to budgets, timelines, and quality standards.
* **Customer Allegiance:** Improve Customer Allegiance Scores (CAS) by maintaining strong relationships with existing clients and identifying new business opportunities.
* **Compliance:** Ensure all team activities align with corporate policies, HR compliance, and safety standards.
* **Mentorship:** Lead, coach, and develop FSEs to upgrade their technical skills and prepare them for future leadership roles.
* **Succession Planning:** Identify and groom a successor through a structured development plan in line with organizational growth.

* **Software Proficiency:** Expert use of Service Management Software and the Microsoft Office suite.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and drive results through persuasion and partnership.
* **Conflict Management:** Skilled at handling difficult customer situations and critical technical escalations with a "soft\-spoken" yet firm professional demeanour.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to balance immediate technical fixes with long\-term business objectives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** **10\+ years** of total working experience.
	+ Minimum **5 years** in Customer Service Management.
	+ **3\+ years** in a direct supervisory/leadership role managing technical teams.
* **Technical Hands\-on:** Experience on Analytical instruments and Direct experience with **XRF/OES/Process analyzers analytical instruments** is additional advantage.
* **Language:** Proficiency in English; multilingual skills are a plus depending on the specific region.

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
**ADP** is hiring a **Lead Product Manager**


* Are you passionate about building products that solve real customer problems?
* Do you thrive at the intersection of business, technology, and customer experience?
* Are you excited about driving product strategy and delivering measurable business outcomes?

**Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to make your mark?**


In this role, you will own and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of marketplace for one of ADP’s HCM offerings. You will work cross\-functionally with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to identify opportunities, validate solutions, and deliver products that create value for our clients and business.


No two days are the same. You may spend one day analyzing customer insights and market trends, another prioritizing features with engineering teams, and the next aligning stakeholders on product direction. From product discovery through launch and optimization, you'll play a key role in creating solutions that improve customer outcomes and support business growth.


To thrive in this role, you'll need a strong foundation in product management, customer\-centric thinking, and data\-driven decision\-making. You'll bring experience defining product strategies, managing roadmaps, and influencing cross\-functional teams. Our most successful Product Managers are curious, adaptable, analytical, and passionate about solving customer challenges through technology.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**


**Product Strategy \& Vision**


* Define and execute product strategy aligned with business goals and customer needs.
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery activities.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and business growth.
* Build and maintain a product roadmap based on customer value and business priorities.

**Product Development \& Execution**


* Gather, analyze, and prioritize product requirements; create specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Collaborate with Engineering and Design throughout the development lifecycle
* Leverage available tools to drive AI adoption into the product development lifecycle

**Customer \& Market Focus**


* Engage with customers to understand their pain points and requirements.
* Analyze customer feedback, usage metrics, and industry trends.
* Translate customer insights into impactful product features and enhancements.
* Ensure product decisions are data\-driven and aligned with market needs.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Partner with Engineering, Operations, and go\-to\-market teams
* Communicate product vision, priorities, and progress to stakeholders
* Influence and drive alignment across teams

**Product Performance Management**


* Define and track key product metrics (adoption, engagement, satisfaction, business outcomes)
* Conduct post\-launch analysis and recommend improvements
* Drive continuous optimization based on performance insights

**TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:**


* You'll have a bachelor's degree OR equivalent.
* 7\-10 years of experience in Product Management or related roles with a proven track record of delivering successful products.
* Experience and understanding of marketplace platforms, APIs and integrations.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, and roadmap planning.
* Experience translating customer needs and business goals into scalable product solutions.
* Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Preferred: Experience in SaaS, cloud\-based platforms, enterprise software, FinTech, or HCM technology solutions.
* Preferred: Certifications such as CSPO, SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner, or Pragmatic Product Management.

**YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:**


* **Collaborate.** Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
* **Deliver at epic scale.** We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
* **Be surrounded by curious learners.** We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
* **Act like an owner \& doer.** Mission\-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems.
* **Give back to others.** Support our associates, clients, and communities through meaningful philanthropic initiatives.
* **Join a company committed to equality and equity.** Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

**What are you waiting for? Apply today!**


**A little about ADP:** We are a comprehensive global provider of cloud\-based human capital management (HCM) solutions that unite HR, payroll, talent, time, tax and benefits administration and a leader in business outsourcing services, analytics, and compliance expertise. title: Product Manager
description:
### **Product Manager**


* JR\-162158
* Hybrid
* Bengaluru
* Technology Enablement
* Full time

**Who are we?**



Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

  


A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.



A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
**Job Summary**



We're building HR and Legal data products that power workforce planning, talent strategy, compliance, and risk management across the enterprise. These products unify data from core systems (HRIS/HCM, ATS, contract lifecycle, and compliance tooling) and are delivered through a unified enterprise analytics and intelligence platform—a trusted single source of reference that exposes insight through APIs, semantic models, dashboards, and conversational and agentic AI experiences.



As Product Manager, you'll help drive the data \& analytics product strategy and roadmap for our Corporate Functions (HR and Legal). You'll partner closely with stakeholders to understand their strategic priorities, operating rhythms (talent review cycles, workforce planning cadence, compliance calendars, contract renewals), and pain points—fragmented data, manual reporting, limited scenario planning, and governance gaps—and translate them into high\-impact, AI\-enabled data products that increase insight precision, automate reporting, and elevate HR and Legal as strategic advisors to the business.



**Responsibilities**


* Partner \& advise: Build trusted relationships with HR and Legal stakeholders by understanding their objectives, operating cadence, and core processes; translate pain points (attrition risk, headcount reconciliation, skills and talent gaps, DEI reporting, contract bottlenecks, compliance governance) into data product solutions. Manage stakeholder expectations within and across functions
* Shape strategy \& roadmap: Support development of the product strategy and an ROI\-informed roadmap, balancing quick\-win delivery with foundational platform efforts
* Build data products: Contribute to function\-grade semantic models (employee, talent, headcount, contract, compliance) that integrate with the enterprise platform, its model store, and query APIs. Help productize analytics and AI/ML services—workforce forecasting, talent dashboards, compliance reporting packs, conversational insights, governance\-enabled data catalogs—while upholding platform principles: system of reference (not system of record), domain data ownership, and full lineage, provenance, and auditability
* Analyze the market: Research industry practices, competitors, and verticals; report on emerging HR and Legal analytics and AI trends (predictive attrition modeling, skills intelligence, contract analytics, compliance automation). Introduce best\-in\-class external practices and governance frameworks (GDPR, data privacy, records compliance)
* Develop business cases: Collaborate on—and may create—financial business models; conduct business opportunity reviews with senior team members
* Measure success: Define metrics that inform product success and drive user experience improvements (adoption, reporting cycle\-time reduction, forecast accuracy, model quality, automation ROI)
* Collaborate cross\-functionally: Work closely with data platform, data science, AI/ML, and engineering teams; support backlog refinement, test case definition and UAT, and design product training curriculum


**Qualifications**


* 7\+ years of experience preferred, ideally with exposure to HR and/or Legal data products
* Bachelor's degree preferred, ideally in Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field
* Familiarity with modern enterprise data platforms, semantic/data modeling, APIs, and AI/ML concepts; experience delivering products on an analytics/intelligence platform is a strong plus
* Understanding of data governance principles—lineage, provenance, auditability, and domain data ownership
* Knowledge of HR and/or Legal concepts (workforce planning, talent management, people analytics, compliance, data privacy, contract lifecycle management) is a strong plus
* Excellent communicator who can simplify the complex and build trusted relationships with business stakeholders
* Ability to work across HR, Legal, IT, Engineering, Data Science, and AI/ML teams
* Bias for action, ownership, and the ability to break down complex problems, drive alignment, and remain decisive

title: Associate - Global TA
description:
**The Specialist Recruiter, Global Talent Acquisition job performs a variety of professional and administrative recruiting functions in support of identifying, interviewing, evaluating, and selecting qualified employees to effectively meet the organization's staffing requirements. Under general supervision, this job is responsible for promoting the organization's image as a desirable place to work and attracting and recommending placement of internal and external candidates for entry\-level and experienced positions.**  

  

**Key Responsibilities and Duties*** **Refers applicants for particular job openings, administers pre\-employment tests, checks references, and conducts exit interviews.**
* **Determines best avenue in recruiting (e.g., advertising, direct contact, employee referrals, research organizations, employment agencies, and job fairs).**
* **Contacts candidates, schedule interviews, and develop interview questions in with the hiring manager so interviews are conducted efficiently and equitably.**
* **Prepares job postings, specifications for recruitment agencies, job descriptions and other materials in accordance with the organization's recruitment standards.**
* **Represents the organization at job fairs to promote the organization to potential candidates.**
* **Responds to inquiries about the organization's recruitment activities and status of job vacancies.**
* **Concludes recruitment process by closing the recruitment requisition and advising unsuccessful candidates in an accurate, timely and compliant manner.**

**Educational Requirements*** **University (Degree) Preferred**

**Work Experience*** **2\+ Years Required; 3\+ Years Preferred**

**Physical Requirements*** **Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work**

  

**Career Level**  

**6IC**  

**About the Role**

**The Contingent Worker Operations Associate is a critical member of the CW Operations team, responsible for managing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of contingent workers across the organization. This role serves as the primary point of contact for contingent worker transactions, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution of all operational processes. The ideal candidate brings a strong process mindset, a high attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lifecycle \& Contract Management:\- The associate manages the complete contingent worker lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, contract extensions, contract changes, Statement of Work (SOW) creation, and manager or location change requests. They ensure all actions are processed accurately and within defined turnaround timelines.**
* **Compliance \& Audit:\- The role is responsible for conducting regular compliance checks and supporting internal and external audits. This includes daily and periodic audits covering active work orders, expired worker engagements, pending requests, and data integrity across systems such as Workday and sPro.**
* **System \& Mailbox Management:\- The associate manages the team's shared mailbox, ensuring timely responses and appropriate triaging of requests. They handle case management through QMS and Workday Help, ensuring all requests are tracked, resolved, and closed within SLAs.**
* **Reporting \& Data Analysis:\- This role is responsible for generating and maintaining operational reports, analyzing workforce data to identify trends, flag anomalies, and support leadership with data\-driven insights on contingent worker activity.**
* **Vendor \& Stakeholder Management:\- The associate maintains strong working relationships with staffing vendors and internal stakeholders including hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and Finance teams. They serve as a trusted operational partner for all contingent workforce\-related queries and escalations.**
* **Process Improvement \& Automation:\- The role actively identifies opportunities to streamline existing processes, reduce manual effort, and contribute to automation initiatives wherever applicable, in partnership with the broader HR Operations and Technology teams.**

**Skills \& Competencies**

* **Technical Skills Experience managing contingent worker programs or HR operations, familiarity with Workday and/or vendor management systems (VMS), and proficiency in data reporting and analysis tools are essential for this role.**

**Behavioral Competencies**

* **The ideal candidate is process\-oriented and meticulous in their work, maintaining a high standard of accuracy and consistency.**

We're building a category\-defining institutional partnerships arm for one of India's fastest\-scaling personalised print and gifting operations — expanding from a single\-city base into a multi\-city, franchise\-backed network across Madhya Pradesh. title: Head of Employee Relations, India
description:
Req ID: 60995
Job Function: HR
Posting Start Date: 23/07/2026
Posting End Date: 03/08/2026
Division: People \& Culture
Job Location: IND\-Gurugram\-IQ
Advertised Salary: Competitive
**Hyrbid working \- 3 days in the office 2 days working from home**

  

**About the role**
------------------

The India Head of Employee Relations leads the full ER and People Relations agenda for BT India across \~14,000 colleagues. The role is responsible for ensuring BT operates a fair, safe, compliant, and values\-driven workplace by driving ER governance, leadership advisory, POSH compliance, labour law readiness, transformation support, investigations, and proactive risk mitigation.

  

This role provides full leadership to the People Partners team who manage ER advisory, investigation support, redeployment, redundancies, manager guidance, business partnering for transformation, and colleague relations.

  

The role is also responsible for interpreting and operationalising India’s Four Labour Codes (Wage Code, Social Security Code, Industrial Relations Code, and OSH Code), leading policy redesign, transformation change, and cross\-functional compliance readiness.

  

Given the scale, regulatory complexity, and risk exposure, this role must be held by leader capable of influencing senior stakeholders, balancing commercial and legal perspectives, driving organisational change, and safeguarding BT’s reputation and culture.


**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* Lead the Employee Relations strategy for BT India, ensuring fair, consistent and timely resolution of complex and sensitive employee matters.
* Provide strategic ER leadership across business transformation, organisational change, workforce planning, redeployment, redundancy and restructuring activity.
* Lead, develop and coach the People Partners team, strengthening advisory capability, stakeholder influence and leadership support across the business.
* Partner with HR, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Security and senior business leaders to manage people risk and enable successful business outcomes.
* Oversee ER governance, reporting, quality assurance, case auditing, documentation standards and continuous process improvement.
* Act as the senior advisor and final authority on disciplinary matters, ensuring consistent, proportionate and legally defensible outcomes.
* Lead BT India's POSH framework, ensuring compliance, robust investigation standards, leadership awareness and proactive risk prevention.
* Provide expert guidance on Indian employment legislation, including Labour Codes, industrial relations, workforce regulations and statutory obligations.
* Lead policy and process redesign to ensure compliance with evolving employment laws and organisational requirements.
* Own employment compliance governance across BT India, including audits, statutory filings, inspections, record keeping and regulatory reporting.
* Represent BT with labour authorities, government bodies and regulators, managing enquiries, inspections and compliance matters.
* Oversee contractor labour compliance, vendor governance and remediation activity where required.
* Monitor external industrial relations trends and advise leaders on emerging risks and organisational impacts.
* Drive manager capability through training and coaching on employee relations, investigations, grievances, conduct, performance and workplace behaviours.
* Promote a culture of fairness, accountability, inclusion and psychological safety, using insights to influence leadership behaviour and organisational culture.
* Build organisational readiness for change by guiding leaders through legal, cultural and operational impacts of transformation initiatives.
**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Employee Relations \& Employment Law Expertise: Deep knowledge of Indian employment law, including the Four Labour Codes, POSH legislation, complex ER investigations, disciplinary processes, redeployment, redundancy and industrial relations advisory.
* Strategic Leadership \& Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to influence and advise senior leaders across India and the UK, make sound decisions in complex situations, and lead organisational change with confidence and credibility.
* Data\-Driven \& People\-Focused Approach: Strong analytical capability with experience using ER metrics and ServiceNow insights, combined with high emotional intelligence, conflict resolution skills and the ability to navigate sensitive employee matters effectively.
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Demonstrates exceptional integrity, discretion and professional courage, handling sensitive and complex employee relations matters with confidentiality, fairness and accountability.
* Exercises balanced judgement and empathy, carefully considering business, legal and people implications to deliver pragmatic and equitable outcomes.
* Exhibits strong executive presence, confidently influencing, challenging and advising senior leaders on high\-risk and business\-critical issues.
* Builds credible and effective stakeholder relationships, fostering collaboration and maintaining constructive engagement across all levels of the organisation.
**Our Package**
---------------

At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

title: Senior Finance Associate / Manager – Accounting & Audit
description:
Here is the updated, neutral Job Description with all specific company references removed.

**Job Description: Senior Finance Associate / Manager – Accounting \& Audit**

**Industry:** EdTech

**Location:** \[JP Nagar, Bangalore]

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Experience Level:** 3–6 Years

**About the Company**

We are a fast\-growing startup building next\-generation learning solutions in the EdTech space. As we continue to expand, we value speed, accountability, and operational excellence. We are seeking a hands\-on, meticulous Finance professional to own our financial reporting, month\-end closures, and audit workflows.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Month\-End \& Year\-End Financial Close**

* Drive the entire **month\-end and year\-end closing process** to ensure timely and accurate closing of books.
* Prepare and post critical journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and provisions in accordance with **Ind AS / Indian GAAP**.
* Perform monthly **reconciliations** of bank accounts, intercompany balances, revenue schedules, and balance sheet line items.
* Maintain fixed asset registers (FAR) and handle depreciation calculations under the Companies Act and Income Tax Act.

**2\. Audit Management \& Compliance**

* Act as the **primary point of contact** for Statutory Auditors, Internal Auditors, and Tax Auditors.
* Prepare comprehensive audit schedules, balance confirmations, and notes to accounts (P\&L and Balance Sheet).
* Resolve audit queries promptly to ensure smooth and clean audit completion within strict deadlines.
* Ensure strict adherence to internal financial controls, accounting policies, and statutory regulations.

**3\. Financial Reporting \& Analysis**

* Prepare monthly Trial Balance, P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements.
* **Variance Analysis:** Compare actual financial performance against budgets and prior periods, identifying key operational drivers.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Operations, Tech, HR) to streamline vendor payments and expense tracking.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** CA (Inter) / Qualified CA / M.Com / MBA in Finance.
* **Experience:** 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in core accounting, financial closes, and external audit support (Startup or EdTech experience is a plus).
* **Technical Expertise:**
* Strong working knowledge of **Ind AS / Indian GAAP** and Schedule III presentation.
* Proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., Zoho Books, Tally, NetSuite, or SAP).
* Advanced **MS Excel** skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data manipulation).
* **Soft Skills:**
* High ownership mindset with the ability to manage tight close schedules independently.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills to interface with auditors and management.
* Adaptability to thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to shape and scale the financial operations of a fast\-growing business.
* Direct working exposure with leadership and key stakeholders.
* Competitive salary package and clear growth trajectory.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹150,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Services Consultant Sr
description:
Dayforce is a global human capital management (HCM) company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and Minneapolis, Minnesota, with operations across North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), and the Asia Pacific Japan (APJ) region.
  
Our award\-winning Cloud HCM platform offers a unified solution database and continuous calculation engine, driving efficiency, productivity and compliance for the global workforce.
  
Our brand promise \- Makes Work Life Better™\- Reflects our commitment to employees, customers, partners and communities globally.
  
  

About the opportunity
  
The Centre of Excellence (CoE) Services Consultant Sr. plays a critical role in the successful delivery of implementation projects by actively participating in key phases of the lifecycle. Working closely with the Project Manager and the project team, the consultant is responsible for delivering high\-quality work on projects, including but not limited to, solutioning, configuration, system readiness, data loads, cutover to production, etc. This role requires a strong understanding of best practices, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across various teams to ensure customer requirements are accurately translated into functional solutions. The consultant contributes to maintaining the delivery standards, identifying potential issues early in the process, and supporting clients throughout the transition to live operations, ensuring a smooth and successful go\-live.
  
What you'll get to do
  
* Collaborate with Project Managers and the project teams to deliver high\-quality implementation services for customers across diverse industries.
* Configure Dayforce application to meet customer’s documented business requirements
* Participate in the implementation lifecycle, including but not limited to solutioning, configuration, system readiness, production cutover activities, etc.
* Attend internal project meetings and provide status on progress of activities and deliverables
* Provide customers with follow\-up consulting and general assistance in areas of expertise

* Assist in identifying process improvements, implementation risks, and mitigation strategies to support successful project outcomes.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing within the CoE by documenting lessons learned, reusable assets, and implementation insights.
* Develop hands\-on expertise with the latest tools, platforms, and methodologies in a fast\-paced, learning\-focused environment.
* Continuously grow your skills by working alongside experienced professionals in a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
* Document solutions and contribute to a solutions repository.
* Complete new release training on a timely basis; be fully versed on new and/or enhanced functionality in each product release.


Skills and experience we value
  
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 6\+ years’ experience in a Software Implementation role or 4\+ years of experience in a WFM Lead Consultant role.
* Experience with one or more of the following applications: SalesForce.com, SAP, PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, Kronos, Workbrain/Infor, RedPrairie/JDA, Ultimate, Oracle HR/Payroll, PeopleSoft, Dayforce (preferred)
* Experience and strong understanding of ANZ region.
* Experience in configuring pay policies, LSL, NZHA, entitlements, workflows, schedules, shift rotations, etc.
* Knowledge of local statutory requirements
* Well versed in HCM terminologies, and best practices
* Working understanding of HCM best practices through on\-the\-job experience
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products
* Experience with HCM software in a SaaS / Cloud computing environment
* Experience with SQL and relational databases is Preferred
* Experience in Importing and Exporting of Employee data loads.
* Basic understanding of XML is an asset
* Understanding of common human capital management (HCM) business practices
* Understanding of different industries and how software can be applied to support customer’s business practices
* Customer relationship acumen
* Ability to engage with multiple projects \& customers at the same time and manage priorities
* Excellent organization, communication, and collaboration skills
* Ability to lead and facilitate customer workshops and sessions


What’s in it for you
  
Dayforce is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment.
  
We encourage individuals to apply based on their passions.
  
Dayforce encourages personal and professional growth. We offer excellent time away from work programs, comprehensive wellness initiatives and recognition through competitive pay and benefits.
  
With a commitment to community impact, including volunteer days and our charity, Dayforce Cares we provide opportunities for you to thrive both in your career and personal life. Our focus is not just on your job but on supporting you to be the best version of yourself.
  
Artificial intelligence may be used in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this position.
  
Fraudulent Recruiting
  
Beware of fraudulent recruiting. Legitimate Dayforce contacts will use an @dayforce.com email address. We do not request money, checks, equipment orders, or sensitive personal data during the recruitment process. If you have been asked for any of the above, or believe you have been contacted by someone posing as a Dayforce employee, please refer to our fraudulent recruiting statement found here: https://www.dayforce.com/be\-aware\-of\-recruiting\-fraud
  
Dayforce actively monitors all job applications to ensure authenticity. Submissions determined to be fraudulent or misleading will be declined from the recruitment process

Dynamic and entrepreneurial culture.

title: Senior US HR & Compliance Specialist – Contract (Trivandrum, US Shift)
description:
**Senior US HR \& Compliance Specialist — Contract, Trivandrum**
----------------------------------------------------------------


**Location:** Trivandrum (Thiruvananthapuram), Kerala  

**Market:** US HR operations and staffing compliance  

**Shift:** US hours (EST / CST overlap required)  

**Engagement:** Contract, 6–12 months, extendable based on performance and volume  

**Compensation:** Commensurate with experience — discussed during the interview


### **Read This First**



This is an expert\-level role. We are not building a training runway. You will own the compliance layer from day one, with no one reviewing your I\-9s behind you. If your experience is in collecting documents for someone else to verify, or you have covered onboarding paperwork without owning work authorization tracking and immigration coordination, this role is not the right fit and we would rather tell you now than at the offer stage. Compliance errors here carry legal and financial consequences, so we are hiring for judgement that is already formed.


### **About the Role**



You will own the paperwork and compliance layer sitting behind every consultant we place from our Trivandrum office: work authorization verification, onboarding documentation, contract paperwork, and audit\-ready record\-keeping. This is a role for someone who reads the fine print, chases the missing document, and does not let an expiry date slip past.


### **What You Will Own**


#### **Onboarding \& Documentation**


* Run end\-to\-end onboarding for US consultants and employees — offer paperwork, background checks, drug screening coordination and start\-date readiness
* Independently complete and verify **Form I\-9**, manage **E\-Verify** cases including tentative nonconfirmations, handle reverifications and correct errors on existing files
* Validate right\-to\-work documents, education and employment verifications without escalation
* Maintain personnel files to inspection standard with correct retention schedules

#### **Work Authorization \& Immigration**


* Own work authorization tracking and expiry control across USC, GC, H1B, H4 EAD, L2 EAD, OPT/CPT and TN populations
* Coordinate directly with immigration attorneys on LCA postings, public access files, H1B amendments, transfers and extensions
* Flag upcoming expiries early and drive renewal follow\-up to closure — no lapses

#### **Contracts \& Engagement Paperwork**


* Prepare and control employment agreements, MSAs, NDAs, right\-to\-represent forms and subcontractor documentation
* Own W2, C2C and 1099 engagement setup and vendor onboarding paperwork
* Maintain a clean contract repository with full renewal and expiry visibility

#### **Compliance \& Reporting**


* Own multi\-state compliance: state registrations, workers compensation, unemployment claims and state wage and hour requirements
* Run FLSA exempt and non\-exempt classification reviews, and EEO\-1 and ACA reporting inputs
* Support timesheet, payroll and invoicing data accuracy in coordination with finance
* Own documentation readiness for internal reviews and client, vendor or agency compliance audits
* Keep HRIS and ATS records accurate, current and audit\-defensible

### **Non\-Negotiable Requirements**


* **5\+ years** in US HR operations, US staffing compliance or HR shared services supporting US clients
* **Independent, hands\-on ownership of I\-9 and E\-Verify** — including reverifications, tentative nonconfirmations and correcting existing file errors. This is the core of the role
* Direct ownership of work authorization tracking across H1B, H4 EAD, OPT/CPT, GC and TN, with expiry follow\-up driven to closure
* Hands\-on coordination with immigration attorneys on LCA postings, public access files or H1B amendments
* Working command of US federal and multi\-state employment compliance applied in real decisions
* Independent preparation of US engagement paperwork — MSAs, NDAs, right\-to\-represent, and W2 / C2C / 1099 setup
* Strong Excel skills and fluency in HRIS or ATS platforms
* Precise written and spoken English for unsupervised contact with US consultants, client HR teams, agencies and attorneys
* Available for US shift hours from Trivandrum
* Graduate degree in HR, Commerce, Law or a related field; HR or compliance certification is a strong plus

### **Strong Advantages**


* Prior experience at a US staffing firm, RPO, EOR or PEO
* Exposure to MSP / VMS portals such as Fieldglass, Beeline or IQNavigator
* Experience preparing for I\-9 audits, SOC 2, ISO or client compliance audits
* Track record of finding and remediating compliance gaps that had passed prior review

### **What We Offer**


* A defined contract engagement with clear scope and extension potential
* Full ownership of US employment law, immigration processes and multi\-state compliance
* A small team where your judgement carries real weight and is not second\-guessed
* Compensation discussed during the interview and aligned to genuine expertise

### **How to Apply**



Send your CV along with a short note covering: which compliance areas you have owned independently, your hands\-on I\-9 and E\-Verify experience including any error remediation, the work authorization types you have tracked, your direct experience with immigration attorneys, and your notice period. Applications that do not address independent ownership will not be shortlisted.


We never charge candidates any fee at any stage of the hiring process.

Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.

The Human Resources function is responsible for providing human resources (HR) support to a major business unit or functional area. This includes any issues relating to talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, employee relations, training and development, and HR operations. The Analytics, Modeling, \& Reporting area is responsible for analyzing and reporting on data sets for a particular area to evaluate, recommend and support the implementation of business strategies and operational processes. The Human Resources Information System (HRIS) and Reporting focus specializes in HRIS and Reporting maintenance and ongoing administration. Oversees the development and implementation of new or redesigned systems, reports, policies, and procedures. Manages relationships with vendors, and the development of training and documentation for system use and maintenance. This job family is in the professional level category and works independently with flexibility and authority over daily work priorities. Incumbents in this job level category may provide work direction to other employees but would not typically have the authority to discipline or reward other employees. There are different levels available that provide clarity on contribution expectations based on knowledge, application, problem solving, and collaboration.  

  

**Job Description:**  

We are looking for a Senior HRIS Analyst to join our global HR Technology team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of our Workday ecosystem. You will partner closely with a global team of analysts and stakeholders to improve processes, resolve complex issues, and expand system capabilities that support our employees worldwide.Depending on your experience level, you will operate as either a high\-level functional lead or a strong technical contributor, helping the team navigate the hire\-to\-retire lifecycle through smart technology solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
* Team\-Based Configuration: Collaborate with P\&T(People \& Talent) and other stakeholders to design, configure and test Workday enhancements across various modules. You will help translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.


* Global Support: Provide high\-level end\-user support; help develop and maintain shared user procedures, guidelines, and system documentation.


* System Integrity: Contribute to the overall health of Workday by participating in business process audits and security reviews. Help the team ensure data compliance and offer fast resolution for high\-impact issues.


* Feature Adoption: Join the team in analyzing, testing, and adopting new functionality from semi\-annual Workday releases to keep our platform at the cutting edge.


* Stakeholder Partnership: Build strong relationships with P\&T partners and COEs to help advance Workday adoption and ensure a user\-friendly experience for all employees.


* Shared Problem Solving: Research system problems and identify opportunities for improvement. You will seek opinions and feedback from the broader team to ensure suggested solutions are robust and global\-ready.


* Reporting \& Insights: Help the business make data\-driven decisions by building and maintaining complex reports, calculated fields, and dashboards.



**Experience \& Qualifications**
**Workday Expertise:**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in Workday configuration.


* We are looking for candidates with experience in one or more functional areas (e.g., Benefits, Payroll, Advanced Compensation, Absence, Talent, Security) but must have a strong HCM background.


* We do not currently have Workday Financials or Recruiting.


* HR Process Knowledge:A strong understanding of global HR processes.


* Collaborative Mindset: A proven ability to work effectively as part of a team in an environment with global members and overlapping time zones.



**Technical Skills:**
* Proficiency with Workday Report Writer and Calculated Fields.


* Experience assisting with data loads and mass updates via EIBs.


* Experience with various HR system configuration outside of Workday a plus (ex. LMS, ATS, Engagement Survey, Rewards).


* Analytical Approach: A strong ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues alongside your peers.


* Adaptability: Ability to manage multiple tasks and contribute to team goals in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.



**Why You’ll Love Working with Us?**



* Work with cutting\-edge technology in a collaborative, global team
* Competitive salary \+ good benefits (insurance, annual leave, bonuses, referral rewards, and more).
* We’re Great Place to Work Certified (4 years in a row!).
* Hybrid work model (3 days in office – Prestige Tech Pacific).
